15.36.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā sthitastatra sabhāsthale ..
papracchātyutsukamanā balistatkṣetravaibhavam ..1..
15.36.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रह्लादस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स्थितस्तत्र सभास्थले ॥
पप्रच्छात्युत्सुकमना बलिस्तत्क्षेत्रवैभवम् ॥1॥
15.36.m: Sūta said: / Having heard Prahlāda's words while standing there in the assembly hall, / Bali, his mind eager, asked about the glory of that sacred field.

15.36.s:
prahlādastadvacaḥ śrutvā bhaktibhāvapuraskṛtam ..
abhinandya ca taṃ premṇā pravaktumupacakrame ..2..
15.36.d:
प्रह्लादस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा भक्तिभावपुरस्कृतम् ॥
अभिनन्द्य च तं प्रेम्णा प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥2॥
15.36.m: Prahlāda, hearing his words preceded by devotional sentiment, / commended him with affection and began to speak.

15.36.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca.. ..
ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ..
puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ bhavati dehinām ..3..
15.36.d:
॥ प्रह्लाद उवाच॥ ॥
एकैकस्मिन्पदे दत्ते पुरीं द्वारवतीं प्रति ॥
पुण्यं क्रतुसहस्राणां फलं भवति देहिनाम् ॥3॥
15.36.m: Prahlāda said: / At every single step taken toward the city of Dvāravatī, / there arises for embodied souls the meritorious fruit of a thousand sacrifices.

15.36.s:
ye'pīcchaṃti manovṛttyā gamanaṃ dvārakāṃ prati ..
teṣāṃ pralīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmāyutārjitam ..4..
15.36.d:
येऽपीच्छंति मनोवृत्त्या गमनं द्वारकां प्रति ॥
तेषां प्रलीयते पापं पूर्वजन्मायुतार्जितम् ॥4॥
15.36.m: Even those who wish in their mental disposition to go toward Dvārakā, / their sin accumulated over ten thousand previous lives dissolves away.

15.36.s:
atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhaṃti vigrahe ..
yāvanna gacchate jaṃtuḥ kalau dvāravatīṃ prati ..5..
15.36.d:
अत्युग्राण्यपि पापानि तावत्तिष्ठंति विग्रहे ॥
यावन्न गच्छते जंतुः कलौ द्वारवतीं प्रति ॥5॥
15.36.m: Even the most terrible sins remain in the body only so long / as a living being does not go toward Dvāravatī in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
lobhenā'pyuparodhena daṃbhena kapaṭena vā ..
cakratīrthe tu yo gacchenna punarviśate bhuvi ..6.
15.36.d:
लोभेनाऽप्युपरोधेन दंभेन कपटेन वा ॥
चक्रतीर्थे तु यो गच्छेन्न पुनर्विशते भुवि ॥6.
15.36.m: Even if through greed, constraint, deceit, or hypocrisy / one goes to Cakratīrtha, he does not enter the earth again.

15.36.s:
hīnavarṇo'pi pāpātmā mṛtaḥ kṛṣṇupurīṃ prati ..
kali kālakṛtairdoṣairatyugrairapi mānavaḥ ..
bhaktyā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā na lipyati kadācana ..7..
15.36.d:
हीनवर्णोऽपि पापात्मा मृतः कृष्णुपुरीं प्रति ॥
कलि कालकृतैर्दोषैरत्युग्रैरपि मानवः ॥
भक्त्या कृष्णमुखं दृष्ट्वा न लिप्यति कदाचन ॥7॥
15.36.m: Even a low-caste person, even an evil-minded one who dies [heading] toward Kṛṣṇa's city, / a person [burdened] even with the most terrible faults caused by the Kali age, / having beheld Kṛṣṇa's face with devotion, is never tainted.

15.36.s:
tāvadvirājate kāśī hyavaṃtī mathurāpurī ..
yāvanna paśyate jaṃtuḥ purīṃ kṛṣṇena pālitām.. 8 ..
15.36.d:
तावद्विराजते काशी ह्यवंती मथुरापुरी ॥
यावन्न पश्यते जंतुः पुरीं कृष्णेन पालिताम्॥ 8 ॥
15.36.m: Kāśī, Avantī, and the city of Mathurā shine only so long / as a creature does not behold the city protected by Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇālaye prāṇā gatā dānavanāyaka ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 9 ..
15.36.d:
येषां कृष्णालये प्राणा गता दानवनायक ॥
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ॥ 9 ॥
15.36.m: Those whose vital breaths have departed in Kṛṣṇa's abode, O chief of Dānavas, / have no return even in hundreds of millions of aeons.

15.36.s:
durlabho dvārakāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam ..
durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ kalau .. 7.4.36.10 ..
15.36.d:
दुर्लभो द्वारकावासो दुर्लभं कृष्णदर्शनम् ॥
दुर्लभं गोमतीस्नानं रुक्मिणीदर्शनं कलौ ॥ 7.4.36.10 ॥
15.36.m: Residence in Dvārakā is rare to obtain; the darśana of Kṛṣṇa is rare to obtain; / ritual ablution in the Gomatī and the darśana of Rukmiṇī are rare to obtain in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
nityaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye smaraṃti gṛhe sthitāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ pātakaṃ kiṃciddehamāśritya tiṣṭhati .. 11 ..
15.36.d:
नित्यं कृष्णपुरीं रम्यां ये स्मरंति गृहे स्थिताः ॥
न तेषां पातकं किंचिद्देहमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति ॥ 11 ॥
15.36.m: Those who, dwelling at home, constantly remember the delightful city of Kṛṣṇa, / no sin whatsoever clings to their body.

15.36.s:
keśavārcā gṛhe yasya na tiṣṭhati mahīpate ..
tasyānnaṃ na ca bhoktavyamabhakṣyeṇa samaṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
15.36.d:
केशवार्चा गृहे यस्य न तिष्ठति महीपते ॥
तस्यान्नं न च भोक्तव्यमभक्ष्येण समं स्मृतम् ॥ 12 ॥
15.36.m: In whose house worship of Keśava does not take place, O king, / his food must not be eaten; it is traditionally regarded as equal to uneatable matter.

15.36.s:
noṣṇatvaṃ dvija rāje vai na śītatvaṃ hutāśane ..
vaiṣṇavānāṃ na pāpatvamekādaśyupavāsinām .. 13 ..
15.36.d:
नोष्णत्वं द्विज राजे वै न शीतत्वं हुताशने ॥
वैष्णवानां न पापत्वमेकादश्युपवासिनाम् ॥ 13 ॥
15.36.m: There is indeed no heat in the moon, nor coldness in fire; / [similarly,] there is no sinfulness in Vaiṣṇavas who fast on the Ekādaśī.

15.36.s:
nāsti nāsti mahābhāgāḥ kalikālasamaṃ yugam ..
smaraṇātkīrttanādviṣṇoḥ prāpyate paramavyayam .. 14 ..
15.36.d:
नास्ति नास्ति महाभागाः कलिकालसमं युगम् ॥
स्मरणात्कीर्त्तनाद्विष्णोः प्राप्यते परमव्ययम् ॥ 14 ॥
15.36.m: There is no yuga, there is no [yuga], O blessed ones, equal to the Kali age: / through the remembrance and chanting of Viṣṇu, the supreme, imperishable [state] is attained.

15.36.s:
satyabhāmāpatiryatra yatra puṇyā ca gomatī ..
narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti tatra snātvā kalau yuge .. 15 ..
15.36.d:
सत्यभामापतिर्यत्र यत्र पुण्या च गोमती ॥
नरा मुक्तिं प्रयास्यंति तत्र स्नात्वा कलौ युगे ॥ 15 ॥
15.36.m: Where the Lord of Satyabhāmā is, and where the holy Gomatī is, / having bathed there in the Kali yuga, men will attain liberation.

15.36.s:
mādhave śuklapakṣe tu trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ yadi ..
labhate dvārakāyāṃ tu nāsti dhanyatarastataḥ .. 16 ..
15.36.d:
माधवे शुक्लपक्षे तु त्रिस्पृशां द्वादशीं यदि ॥
लभते द्वारकायां तु नास्ति धन्यतरस्ततः ॥ 16 ॥
15.36.m: If in the bright fortnight of the month of Mādhava one encounters / a Trispṛśā Dvādaśī in Dvārakā, there is none more fortunate than he.

15.36.s:
trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ prāpya gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ ..
yaḥ karoti harerbhaktyā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet.. 17 ..
15.36.d:
त्रिस्पृशां द्वादशीं प्राप्य गत्वा कृष्णपुरीं नरः ॥
यः करोति हरेर्भक्त्या सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्॥ 17 ॥
15.36.m: Encountering a Trispṛśā Dvādaśī, a man who has gone to Kṛṣṇa's city / and performs [worship] with devotion to Hari obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

15.36.s:
naṃdāyāṃ tu jayāyāṃ vai bhadrā caiva bhavedyadi ..
upavāsārcane gīte durllabhā kṛṣṇasannidhau ..18..
15.36.d:
नंदायां तु जयायां वै भद्रा चैव भवेद्यदि ॥
उपवासार्चने गीते दुर्ल्लभा कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥18॥
15.36.m: If on Nandā or Jayā there is indeed Bhadrā, / fasting, worship, and song in the presence of Kṛṣṇa are rare to attain.

15.36.s:
udayaikādaśī svalpā aṃte caiva trayodaśī ..
saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī madhye trispṛśā ca hareḥ priyā .. 19 ..
15.36.d:
उदयैकादशी स्वल्पा अंते चैव त्रयोदशी ॥
संपूर्णा द्वादशी मध्ये त्रिस्पृशा च हरेः प्रिया ॥ 19 ॥
15.36.m: A brief Ekādaśī at sunrise, and Trayodaśī at the end, / and a complete Dvādaśī in the middle is Trispṛśā, dear to Hari.

15.36.s:
ekena copavāsena upavāsā'yutaṃ phalam ..
jāgare śatasāhasraṃ nṛtye koṭiguṇaṃ kalau .. 7.4.36.20 ..
15.36.d:
एकेन चोपवासेन उपवासाऽयुतं फलम् ॥
जागरे शतसाहस्रं नृत्ये कोटिगुणं कलौ ॥ 7.4.36.20 ॥
15.36.m: By a single fast, the fruit of ten thousand fasts is obtained; / in keeping vigil, a hundred thousandfold; in dancing, a crore-fold in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
tatphalaṃ labhate marttyo dvārakāyāṃ dinedine ..
gṛheṣu vasatāmetatkiṃ punaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. .. 21 ..
15.36.d:
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्त्यो द्वारकायां दिनेदिने ॥
गृहेषु वसतामेतत्किं पुनः कृष्णसंनिधौ ॥ ॥ 21 ॥
15.36.m: A mortal obtains that fruit day by day in Dvārakā; / this is [the fruit] for those dwelling in their homes, how much more in the presence of Kṛṣṇa!

15.36.s:
vāṅmanaḥkāyajairdoṣairhatā ye pāpabuddhayaḥ ..
dvāravatyāṃ vimucyaṃte dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ śubham .. 22 ..
15.36.d:
वाङ्मनःकायजैर्दोषैर्हता ये पापबुद्धयः ॥
द्वारवत्यां विमुच्यंते दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमुखं शुभम् ॥ 22 ॥
15.36.m: Those evil-minded ones afflicted by faults born of speech, mind, and body, / are liberated in Dvāravatī upon beholding the auspicious face of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s: daityeśvara narāḥ ślāghyā dvāravatyāṃ gatāśca ye .. 23 ..
15.36.d: दैत्येश्वर नराः श्लाघ्या द्वारवत्यां गताश्च ये ॥ 23 ॥
15.36.m: O lord of the Daityas, those men are praiseworthy who have gone to Dvāravatī.

15.36.s:
durllabhānīha tīrthāni durlabhāḥ parvatottamāḥ ..
durllabhā vaiṣṇavā loke dvārakāvasatiḥ kalau .. 24 ..
15.36.d:
दुर्ल्लभानीह तीर्थानि दुर्लभाः पर्वतोत्तमाः ॥
दुर्ल्लभा वैष्णवा लोके द्वारकावसतिः कलौ ॥ 24 ॥
15.36.m: Rare to find in this world are sacred fords, rare to find are supreme mountains, / rare to find are Vaiṣṇavas in the world, [and rare to find is] residence in Dvārakā in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi ratnako ṭiśatāni ca ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 25 ..
15.36.d:
गवां कोटिसहस्राणि रत्नको टिशतानि च ॥
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥ 25 ॥
15.36.m: The fruit one obtains by giving thousands of crores of cows / and hundreds of crores of jewels, that [very] fruit [is obtained] in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
yasyāḥ sīmāṃ praviṣṭasya brahmahatyādipātakam ..
naśyate darśanādeva tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 26 ..
15.36.d:
यस्याः सीमां प्रविष्टस्य ब्रह्महत्यादिपातकम् ॥
नश्यते दर्शनादेव तां पुरीं को न सेवते ॥ 26 ॥
15.36.m: For one who has crossed its boundary, sins such as the slaying of a brahmin / are destroyed simply by beholding it—who would not resort to that city?

15.36.s:
cakrāṃkitā śilā yatra gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
yacchati pūjitā mokṣaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate .. 27 ..
15.36.d:
चक्रांकिता शिला यत्र गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ॥
यच्छति पूजिता मोक्षं तां पुरीं को न सेवते ॥ 27 ॥
15.36.m: Where at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean the stone marked with a discus, / when worshipped, bestows liberation—who would not resort to that city?

15.36.s:
siṃhasthe ca gurau viprā godāvaryyāṃ tu yatphalam..
tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 28 ..
15.36.d:
सिंहस्थे च गुरौ विप्रा गोदावर्य्यां तु यत्फलम्॥
तत्फलं स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥ 28 ॥
15.36.m: The fruit [attained] at the Godāvarī when Jupiter is in Leo, O brahmins, / that [very] fruit is attained merely by bathing in the Gomatī in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
dvārakā'vasthitaṃ toyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ pibate naraḥ ..
tasya cakrāṃkito deho bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29 ..
15.36.d:
द्वारकाऽवस्थितं तोयं षण्मासं पिबते नरः ॥
तस्य चक्रांकितो देहो भवते नात्र संशयः ॥ 29 ॥
15.36.m: If a man drinks water situated in Dvārakā for six months, / his body becomes marked with a discus; there is no doubt in this.

15.36.s:
manvantarasahasrāṇi kāśīvāsena yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca vasataḥ paṃcabhirddinaiḥ .. 7.4.36.30 ..
15.36.d:
मन्वन्तरसहस्राणि काशीवासेन यत्फलम् ॥
तत्फलं द्वारकायां च वसतः पंचभिर्द्दिनैः ॥ 7.4.36.30 ॥
15.36.m: The fruit that [comes] from living in Kāśī for thousands of manvantaras, / that fruit [is gained] by one dwelling in Dvārakā for five days.

15.36.s:
tāvanmṛtaprajā nārī durbhagā daityapuṃgava ..
yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapriyāṃ purīm .. 31 ..
15.36.d:
तावन्मृतप्रजा नारी दुर्भगा दैत्यपुंगव ॥
यावन्न पश्यते भक्त्या कलौ कृष्णप्रियां पुरीम् ॥ 31 ॥
15.36.m: A woman has dead offspring and misfortune, O bull among the Daityas, / only so long as she does not behold with devotion Kṛṣṇa's beloved city in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca devīṃ jāṃbavatīṃ tathā ..
mitraviṃdāṃ ca kāliṃdīṃ bhadrāṃ nāgnajitīṃ tathā .. 32 ..
15.36.d:
रुक्मिणीं सत्यभामां च देवीं जांबवतीं तथा ॥
मित्रविंदां च कालिंदीं भद्रां नाग्नजितीं तथा ॥ 32 ॥
15.36.m: Rukmiṇī, Satyabhāmā, and Queen Jāmbavatī, / Mitravindā, Kālindī, Bhadrā, and Nāgnajitī,

15.36.s:
saṃpūjya lakṣmaṇāṃ tatra vaiṣṇavīḥ kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ ..
etāḥ saṃpūjya vidhivacchreṣṭhaputraśca labhyate .. 33 ..
15.36.d:
संपूज्य लक्ष्मणां तत्र वैष्णवीः कृष्णवल्लभाः ॥
एताः संपूज्य विधिवच्छ्रेष्ठपुत्रश्च लभ्यते ॥ 33 ॥
15.36.m: having worshipped Lakṣmaṇā there—the Vaiṣṇava queens beloved of Kṛṣṇa— / having worshipped these according to rule, an excellent son is obtained.

15.36.s:
tāvadbhavabhayaṃ puṃsāṃ gṛhabhaṃgaśca mūrkhatā ..
yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ .. 34 ..
15.36.d:
तावद्भवभयं पुंसां गृहभंगश्च मूर्खता ॥
यावन्न पश्यते भक्त्या कलौ कृष्णपुरीं नरः ॥ 34 ॥
15.36.m: There is fear of worldly existence, ruin of household, and foolishness for men only so long / as a person does not behold Kṛṣṇa's city with devotion in the Kali [age].

15.36.s:
na sarvatra mahāpuṇyaṃ saṃgame saritāṃpateḥ ..
jāhnavīsaṃgamānmuktirgomatīnīrasaṃgamāt ..
saṃparke gomatīnīrapūto'haṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau .. 35 ..
15.36.d:
न सर्वत्र महापुण्यं संगमे सरितांपतेः ॥
जाह्नवीसंगमान्मुक्तिर्गोमतीनीरसंगमात् ॥
संपर्के गोमतीनीरपूतोऽहं कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥ 35 ॥
15.36.m: Not everywhere is there great merit at a confluence with the lord of rivers; / from confluence with the Jāhnavī comes liberation, [and] from confluence with the waters of the Gomatī; / by contact with the waters of the Gomatī, I am purified in the presence of Kṛṣṇa.

15.36.s:
gomatīnīrasaṃpṛktaṃ ye māṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirityāha saritāṃpatiḥ .. 36 ..
15.36.d:
गोमतीनीरसंपृक्तं ये मां पश्यंति मानवाः ॥
न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिरित्याह सरितांपतिः ॥ 36 ॥
15.36.m: "Those mortals who behold me mingled with the water of the Gomatī / do not return again," so said the lord of rivers.

15.36.s:
dvārakāṃ gacchamānasya vipattiśca bhavedyadi ..
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 37 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakādarśanagomatīsaritsnānavidhimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 36..
15.36.d:
द्वारकां गच्छमानस्य विपत्तिश्च भवेद्यदि ॥
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ॥ 37 ॥
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकादर्शनगोमतीसरित्स्नानविधिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ 36॥
15.36.m:
If misfortune should overtake one going to Dvārakā, / he does not return again, even in hundreds of millions of kalpas.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Rule and Māhātmya of the Darśana of Dvārakā and the Bath in the Gomatī River,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.37.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti śvapaco jāgaranniśi ..
japedapi kalau nityaṃ kṛṣṇarūpī bhaveddhi saḥ .. 1 ..
15.37.d:
॥ श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्णकृष्णेति कृष्णेति श्वपचो जागरन्निशि ॥
जपेदपि कलौ नित्यं कृष्णरूपी भवेद्धि सः ॥ 1 ॥
15.37.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / If even a dog-eater, staying awake at night in the Kali age, / should constantly recite, "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa," he verily takes on Kṛṣṇa's form.

15.37.s:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti kalau vadatyaharniśam ..
nityaṃ yajñāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthakoṭisamudbhavam .. 2 ..
15.37.d:
कृष्णकृष्णेति कृष्णेति कलौ वदत्यहर्निशम् ॥
नित्यं यज्ञायुतं पुण्यं तीर्थकोटिसमुद्भवम् ॥ 2 ॥
15.37.m: One who says "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" day and night in the Kali age / constantly obtains the merit of ten thousand sacrifices, arising from ten million sacred fords.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ varddhate yadi ..
unmīlinīti vikhyātā tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ ..3..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णैकादशी भूत्वा द्वादश्यां वर्द्धते यदि ॥
उन्मीलिनीति विख्याता तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः ॥3॥
15.37.m: When a full Ekādaśī extends into Dvādaśī, / it is known as Unmīlinī, the best of lunar days.

15.37.s:
vaṃjulīvāsare ye vai rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram..
yajñāyutāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ muhūrtārddhena jāyate..4..
15.37.d:
वंजुलीवासरे ये वै रात्रौ कुर्वंति जागरम्॥
यज्ञायुतायुतं पुण्यं मुहूर्तार्द्धेन जायते॥4॥
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil at night on the day of Vañjulī / obtain the merit of ten thousand myriad sacrifices in half a muhūrta.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī bhūtvā varddhate cāpare dine ..
trayodaśyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā vaṃjulī durllabhā kalau .. 5 ..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णा द्वादशी भूत्वा वर्द्धते चापरे दिने ॥
त्रयोदश्यां मुनिश्रेष्ठा वंजुली दुर्ल्लभा कलौ ॥ 5 ॥
15.37.m: When a full Dvādaśī extends into the next day, / the Trayodaśī, O best of sages, that Vañjulī is rare to obtain in the Kali age.

15.37.s:
unmīlinīmanuprāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram ..
nimiṣārddhena tatpuṇyaṃ gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam .. 6..
15.37.d:
उन्मीलिनीमनुप्राप्य ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् ॥
निमिषार्द्धेन तत्पुण्यं गवां कोटिफलप्रदम् ॥ 6॥
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil on reaching an Unmīlinī / obtain in half a twinkling of an eye that merit which grants the fruit of ten million cows.

15.37.s:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā pratya'haṃ varddhate yadi ..
darśaśca paurṇamāsī ca pakṣavṛddhistathocyate ..7..
15.37.d:
संपूर्णैकादशी भूत्वा प्रत्यऽहं वर्द्धते यदि ॥
दर्शश्च पौर्णमासी च पक्षवृद्धिस्तथोच्यते ॥7॥
15.37.m: When a full Ekādaśī extends into the next day, / and likewise the new moon and full moon, that is called Pakṣavṛddhi.

15.37.s:
pakṣavṛddhikarīṃ prāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram ..
nimiṣārddhārddhamātreṇa gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam .. 8 ..
15.37.d:
पक्षवृद्धिकरीं प्राप्य ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् ॥
निमिषार्द्धार्द्धमात्रेण गवां कोटिफलप्रदम् ॥ 8 ॥
15.37.m: Those who keep a vigil on reaching the [tithi] that causes the Pakṣavṛddhi, / obtain in the measure of a quarter of a twinkling of an eye the fruit of ten million cows.

15.37.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarva kilbiṣaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam .. 9 ..
15.37.d:
॥ श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
चक्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्व किल्बिषैः ॥
स याति परमं स्थानं दाहप्रलयवर्जितम् ॥ 9 ॥
15.37.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / Having bathed at the Cakra-tīrtha, a man is freed from all sins; / he goes to the supreme abode, free from burning and dissolution.

15.37.s:
cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra kṛṣṇena svayameva hi ..
tena vai cakratīrthaṃ hi puṇyaṃ ca paramaṃ hareḥ ..
bhavaṃti tatra pāṣāṇāścakrāṃkā muktidāyakāḥ .. 7.4.37.10 ..
15.37.d:
चक्रं प्रक्षालितं यत्र कृष्णेन स्वयमेव हि ॥
तेन वै चक्रतीर्थं हि पुण्यं च परमं हरेः ॥
भवंति तत्र पाषाणाश्चक्रांका मुक्तिदायकाः ॥ 7.4.37.10 ॥
15.37.m: Where the discus was washed by Kṛṣṇa himself, / on that account indeed it is the Cakra-tīrtha, Hari's supreme and holy [ford]. / The stones there, marked with discuses, bestow liberation.

15.37.s:
tatraiva yadi labhyaṃte cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ saha ..
dvādaśātmā sa vijñeyo mokṣadaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. .. 11 ..
15.37.d:
तत्रैव यदि लभ्यंते चक्रैर्द्वादशभिः सह ॥
द्वादशात्मा स विज्ञेयो मोक्षदः परिकीर्तितः ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
15.37.m: If [a stone] is found right there with twelve discuses, / it is to be known as Dvādaśātmā, celebrated as the bestower of liberation.

15.37.s:
ekacakreṇa pāṣāṇo dvāravatyāṃ suśobhanaḥ ..
sudarśanābhidheyosau mokṣaikaphaladāyakaḥ ..12..
15.37.d:
एकचक्रेण पाषाणो द्वारवत्यां सुशोभनः ॥
सुदर्शनाभिधेयोसौ मोक्षैकफलदायकः ॥12॥
15.37.m: A beautiful stone with a single discus in Dvāravatī / is named Sudarśana; it bestows the singular fruit of liberation.

15.37.s:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau dvau tau bhuktimuktiphalapradau ..
tribhiścaivācyutaṃ devaṃ sadendrapadadāyakam .. 13 ..
15.37.d:
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ द्वौ तौ भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदौ ॥
त्रिभिश्चैवाच्युतं देवं सदेन्द्रपददायकम् ॥ 13 ॥
15.37.m: One with two [discuses] is Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, bestowing the fruit of enjoyment and liberation. / With three, it is the god Acyuta, ever bestowing the rank of Indra.

15.37.s:
bhūtido vighnahaṃtā ca catuścakro janārddanaḥ ..
pañcabhirvāsudevastu janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ .. 14 ..
15.37.d:
भूतिदो विघ्नहंता च चतुश्चक्रो जनार्द्दनः ॥
पञ्चभिर्वासुदेवस्तु जन्ममृत्युभयापहः ॥ 14 ॥
15.37.m: With four discuses, Janārdana grants prosperity and destroys obstacles. / With five, Vāsudeva takes away the fear of birth and death.

15.37.s:
pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhirevāsau lakṣmīṃ kāṃtiṃ dadāti ca ..
saptabhirbaladevastu gotrakīrtivivarddhanaḥ .. 15 ..
15.37.d:
प्रद्युम्नः षड्भिरेवासौ लक्ष्मीं कांतिं ददाति च ॥
सप्तभिर्बलदेवस्तु गोत्रकीर्तिविवर्द्धनः ॥ 15 ॥
15.37.m: With six, Pradyumna gives fortune and beauty. / With seven, Baladeva increases lineage and fame.

15.37.s:
vāṃchitaṃ cāṣṭabhirbhaktyā dadāti puruṣottamaḥ ..
sarvaṃ dadyānnavavyūho durllabho yaḥ surottamaiḥ .. 16 ..
15.37.d:
वांछितं चाष्टभिर्भक्त्या ददाति पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
सर्वं दद्यान्नवव्यूहो दुर्ल्लभो यः सुरोत्तमैः ॥ 16 ॥
15.37.m: With eight, Puruṣottama grants desires through devotion. / The ninefold form (Navavyūha), hard to attain even for the best of gods, bestows everything.

15.37.s:
rājyaprado daśabhistu daśāvatāra eva ca ..
ekādaśabhiraiśvaryyamaniruddhaḥ prayacchati .. 17 ..
15.37.d:
राज्यप्रदो दशभिस्तु दशावतार एव च ॥
एकादशभिरैश्वर्य्यमनिरुद्धः प्रयच्छति ॥ 17 ॥
15.37.m: With ten, Daśāvatāra bestows kingship. / With eleven, Aniruddha gives sovereignty.

15.37.s:
nirvāṇaṃ dvādaśātmā tu cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ smṛtam ..
ata ūrdhvamanaṃto'sau saukhyamokṣapradāyakaḥ .. 18 ..
15.37.d:
निर्वाणं द्वादशात्मा तु चक्रैर्द्वादशभिः स्मृतम् ॥
अत ऊर्ध्वमनंतोऽसौ सौख्यमोक्षप्रदायकः ॥ 18 ॥
15.37.m: With twelve discuses it is remembered as Dvādaśātmā, [bestowing] nirvāṇa; / beyond this is Ananta, the bestower of happiness and liberation.

15.37.s:
ye kecittatra pāṣāṇāḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa mudritāḥ..
teṣāṃ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 19 ..
15.37.d:
ये केचित्तत्र पाषाणाः कृष्णचक्रेण मुद्रिताः॥
तेषां स्पर्शनमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥ 19 ॥
15.37.m: Whatever stones there are that are stamped with Kṛṣṇa's discus— / by merely touching them one is freed from all sins.

15.37.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmajam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti cakrāṃkitaprapūjanāt ..7.4.37.20..
15.37.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं मनोवाक्कायकर्मजम् ॥
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति चक्रांकितप्रपूजनात् ॥7.4.37.20॥
15.37.m: Sin such as the slaying of a brahmin, born of the actions of mind, speech, and body— / all that dissolves away by worshiping the discus-marked [stone].

15.37.s:
mlecchadeśe śubhe vā'pi cakrāṃko yatra tiṣṭhati ..
yojanāni daśa dve ca mama kṣetraṃ ca sundari .. 21 ..
15.37.d:
म्लेच्छदेशे शुभे वाऽपि चक्रांको यत्र तिष्ठति ॥
योजनानि दश द्वे च मम क्षेत्रं च सुन्दरि ॥ 21 ॥
15.37.m: Whether in an impure barbarian land or an auspicious one, wherever the discus-marked [stone] resides, / for twelve yojanas around, O fair one, is my sacred field.

15.37.s:
mṛtyukāle ca saṃprāpte hṛdaye yastu dhārayet ..
cakrākaṃ pāpadalanaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 22 ..
15.37.d:
मृत्युकाले च संप्राप्ते हृदये यस्तु धारयेत् ॥
चक्राकं पापदलनं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ 22 ॥
15.37.m: And when the time of death arrives, whoever holds upon his chest / the discus-marked [stone] which destroys sins, he goes to the supreme state.

15.37.s:
gomatīsaṃgame snātvā bhṛgutīrthe tathaiva ca ..
na māturvasate kukṣau yadyapi syātsa pātakī .. .. 23 ..
15.37.d:
गोमतीसंगमे स्नात्वा भृगुतीर्थे तथैव च ॥
न मातुर्वसते कुक्षौ यद्यपि स्यात्स पातकी ॥ ॥ 23 ॥
15.37.m: Having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī and likewise at the Bhṛgu-tīrtha, / he does not dwell in a mother's womb, even if he be a sinner.

15.37.s:
tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ vāpi yatkṛtaṃ viṣṇupūjanam ..
tatsāttvikatvamabhyeti nimnagāṃbho yathārṇave .. 24 ..
15.37.d:
तामसं राजसं वापि यत्कृतं विष्णुपूजनम् ॥
तत्सात्त्विकत्वमभ्येति निम्नगांभो यथार्णवे ॥ 24 ॥
15.37.m: Whatever worship of Viṣṇu is performed, be it tāmasic or rājasic, / it attains sattva, just as river water [becomes ocean water] in the ocean.

15.37.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakākṣetrasthasudarśanapramukhānantāntacakracihnāṃkita pāṣāṇamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakatatpūjanaphalādikathanaṃnāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ..37.. .
15.37.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकाक्षेत्रस्थसुदर्शनप्रमुखानन्तान्तचक्रचिह्नांकित पाषाणमाहात्म्यवर्णनपूर्वकतत्पूजनफलादिकथनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः ॥37॥ ।
15.37.m: Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Narration of the Fruits of Worshiping Stones Marked with Discus Marks Beginning with Sudarśana and Ending with Ananta Located in the Dvārakā Field,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍe, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.38.s:
..śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pautra mayoditam ..
śṛṇvato gadataścāpi muktiḥ kṛṣṇādbhaveddhruvam .. 1 ..
15.38.d:
॥श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं शृणु पौत्र मयोदितम् ॥
शृण्वतो गदतश्चापि मुक्तिः कृष्णाद्भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 1 ॥
15.38.m: The glorious Prahlāda said: / O grandson, hear the māhātmya of Dvārakā spoken by me. / For one who hears and one who recites, liberation through Kṛṣṇa surely comes to pass.

15.38.s:
putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇānantyamaśnute ..
atha putrasya pautreṇa nākamevādhirohati..2..
15.38.d:
पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति पौत्रेणानन्त्यमश्नुते ॥
अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण नाकमेवाधिरोहति॥2॥
15.38.m: Through a son one conquers worlds; through a grandson one enjoys eternity; / then through a great-grandson one ascends even to heaven.

15.38.s:
yasya putraḥ śucirdakṣaḥ pūrve vayasi dhārmikaḥ ..
viṣṇubhaktiṃ ca kurute taṃ putraṃ kavayo viduḥ .. 3 ..
15.38.d:
यस्य पुत्रः शुचिर्दक्षः पूर्वे वयसि धार्मिकः ॥
विष्णुभक्तिं च कुरुते तं पुत्रं कवयो विदुः ॥ 3 ॥
15.38.m: Whose son is pure, capable, righteous in his early age, / and practices devotion to Viṣṇu—the wise recognize him as a [true] son.

15.38.s:
hemaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ savatsaṃ kāṃsyadohanam..
savastraṃ kapilānāṃ tu sahasraṃ ca dinedine .. 4 ..
15.38.d:
हेमशृंगं रौप्यखुरं सवत्सं कांस्यदोहनम्॥
सवस्त्रं कपिलानां तु सहस्रं च दिनेदिने ॥ 4 ॥
15.38.m: Having gold-tipped horns, silver hooves, accompanied by a calf, a bronze milking vessel, / along with garments—a thousand Kapila cows day after day—

15.38.s:
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ madhubhiddine .. 5 ..
15.38.d:
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ॥
तत्फलं स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां मधुभिद्दिने ॥ 5 ॥
15.38.m: the fruit one attains by giving [such cows] to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / that fruit is obtained merely by bathing in the Gomatī on the day of the Slayer of Madhu.

15.38.s:
yastvekaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃsthitam ..
subhikṣe bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet..6..
15.38.d:
यस्त्वेकं भोजयेद्विप्रं द्वारकायां च संस्थितम् ॥
सुभिक्षे भो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः फलं लक्षगुणं भवेत्॥6॥
15.38.m: If one feeds even a single vipra dwelling in Dvārakā / in times of plenty, O best of twice-born, the fruit is multiplied a hundred thousand times.

15.38.s:
phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ durbhikṣe kṛṣṇasannidhau..
evaṃ dharmānusāreṇa dayādbhikṣāṃ tu bhikṣuke .. 7 ..
15.38.d:
फलं लक्षगुणं प्रोक्तं दुर्भिक्षे कृष्णसन्निधौ॥
एवं धर्मानुसारेण दयाद्भिक्षां तु भिक्षुके ॥ 7 ॥
15.38.m: The fruit is declared to be multiplied a hundred thousand times in famine in the presence of Kṛṣṇa. / In this way, according to dharma, one should give alms to an ascetic.

15.38.s:
api naḥ sa kule kaścidbhaviṣyati narottamaḥ ..
yo yatīno kalau prāpte pitṝnuddiśya dāsyati .. 8 ..
15.38.d:
अपि नः स कुले कश्चिद्भविष्यति नरोत्तमः ॥
यो यतीनो कलौ प्राप्ते पितॄनुद्दिश्य दास्यति ॥ 8 ॥
15.38.m: Will there be someone in our family, a best of men, / who, when the Kali age arrives, will give to ascetics with the ancestors in mind,

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāṃ viśe ṣeṇa satkṛtya kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
annadānaṃ yatīnāṃ tu kaupīnācchādanāni ca .. 9 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायां विशे षेण सत्कृत्य कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥
अन्नदानं यतीनां तु कौपीनाच्छादनानि च ॥ 9 ॥
15.38.m: especially in Dvārakā, having honored them in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / gifts of food to ascetics and loincloths and garments?

15.38.s:
nātmanaḥ kratubhiḥ sviṣṭairnāsti tīrthaiḥ prayojanam..
yatra vā tatra vā kāryyaṃ yatīnāṃ prīṇanaṃ sadā .. 7.4.38.10 ..
15.38.d:
नात्मनः क्रतुभिः स्विष्टैर्नास्ति तीर्थैः प्रयोजनम्॥
यत्र वा तत्र वा कार्य्यं यतीनां प्रीणनं सदा ॥ 7.4.38.10 ॥
15.38.m: There is no need for one's own well-offered sacrifices, nor is there any need for sacred fords; / everywhere and anywhere, the pleasing of ascetics is always to be done.

15.38.s:
śvapacādayo'pi te dhanyā ye gatā dvārakāṃ purīm ..
prāpya bhāgavatānye vai pitṝnuddiśya putrakāḥ .. .. 11 ..
15.38.d:
श्वपचादयोऽपि ते धन्या ये गता द्वारकां पुरीम् ॥
प्राप्य भागवतान्ये वै पितॄनुद्दिश्य पुत्रकाः ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
15.38.m: Even those dog-eaters and others are blessed who have gone to the city of Dvārakā; / having reached the devotees of Bhagavān, those sons, on behalf of their ancestors,

15.38.s: bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti vastrairdānaiśca bhūribhiḥ .. 12 ..
15.38.d: भक्त्या संपूजयिष्यंति वस्त्रैर्दानैश्च भूरिभिः ॥ 12 ॥
15.38.m: will worship them with devotion, with clothes and abundant gifts.

15.38.s:
gayāpiṃḍena nāsmākaṃ tṛptirbhavati tādṛśī ..
yādṛśī viṣṇubhaktānāṃ satkāreṇopa jāyate .. 13 ..
15.38.d:
गयापिंडेन नास्माकं तृप्तिर्भवति तादृशी ॥
यादृशी विष्णुभक्तानां सत्कारेणोप जायते ॥ 13 ॥
15.38.m: We do not experience such satisfaction from a funerary ball offered at Gayā / as that which arises from the hospitable honoring of Viṣṇu's devotees.

15.38.s:
vaiśākhe ye kariṣyaṃti dvādaśīṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjayantaśca rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram ..14..
15.38.d:
वैशाखे ये करिष्यंति द्वादशीं कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥
कृष्णं संपूजयन्तश्च रात्रौ कुर्वंति जागरम् ॥14॥
15.38.m: Those who observe the twelfth day in Vaiśākha in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / and, worshiping Kṛṣṇa, keep vigil at night, 14

15.38.s:
māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ śubham ..
kṛṣṇasya bālacaritaṃ bālakṛṣṇādidarśanam .. 15 ..
15.38.d:
माहात्म्यं पठनीयं तु द्वारकासंभवं शुभम् ॥
कृष्णस्य बालचरितं बालकृष्णादिदर्शनम् ॥ 15 ॥
15.38.m: the auspicious māhātmya arising from Dvārakā is certainly to be recited [by them]— / Kṛṣṇa's childhood exploits, the darśana of the child Kṛṣṇa and the rest, 15

15.38.s:
krīḍanaṃ gokulasyaiva krīḍā gopījanasya ca ..
kṛṣṇāvatārakarmāṇi śrotavyāni punaḥpunaḥ .. 16 ..
15.38.d:
क्रीडनं गोकुलस्यैव क्रीडा गोपीजनस्य च ॥
कृष्णावतारकर्माणि श्रोतव्यानि पुनःपुनः ॥ 16 ॥
15.38.m: the play of Gokula itself, and the dalliance with the cowherd women; / the deeds of Kṛṣṇa's incarnations are to be heard again and again. 16

15.38.s:
rukmaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitām..
savatsāṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā homārthaṃ cāhitāgnaye .. 17 ..
15.38.d:
रुक्मशृंगीं रौप्यखुरीं मुक्तालांगूलभूषिताम्॥
सवत्सां ब्राह्मणे दत्त्वा होमार्थं चाहिताग्नये ॥ 17 ॥
15.38.m: Having given a cow with golden horns, silver hooves, adorned with a pearl tail, / together with her calf, to a brahmin who maintains the sacred fires for the sake of oblation, 17

15.38.s:
nimiṣasparśanāṃśena phalaṃ kṛṣṇasya jāgare ..
yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ koṭijanmasu mānavaḥ ..
kṛṣṇasya jāgare rātrau dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
15.38.d:
निमिषस्पर्शनांशेन फलं कृष्णस्य जागरे ॥
यत्किंचित्कुरुते पापं कोटिजन्मसु मानवः ॥
कृष्णस्य जागरे रात्रौ दहते नात्र संशयः ॥ 18 ॥
15.38.m: [even] a fraction of touching for a moment during Kṛṣṇa's vigil [equals] that fruit. / Whatever sin a man commits across ten million lifetimes / burns away during the night vigil of Kṛṣṇa, of this there is no doubt. 18

15.38.s:
paṭhedbhāgavataṃ rātrau purāṇaṃ dayitaṃ hareḥ ..
yāvatsūryyakṛtā''loko yāvaccandrakṛtā niśā .. 19 ..
15.38.d:
पठेद्भागवतं रात्रौ पुराणं दयितं हरेः ॥
यावत्सूर्य्यकृता'ऽलोको यावच्चन्द्रकृता निशा ॥ 19 ॥
15.38.m: One should recite at night the Bhāgavata Purāṇa, beloved of Hari. / As long as the day is illuminated by the sun, as long as the night is illuminated by the moon, 19

15.38.s:
yāvatsasāgarā pṛthvī yāvacca kulaparvatāḥ ..
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge nānyathā mama bhāṣitam .. 7.4.38.20 ..
15.38.d:
यावत्ससागरा पृथ्वी यावच्च कुलपर्वताः ॥
तावत्कालं वसेत्स्वर्गे नान्यथा मम भाषितम् ॥ 7.4.38.20 ॥
15.38.m: as long as the earth has oceans, and as long as the principal mountain ranges endure, / for that length of time he shall dwell in heaven; my word is not otherwise. 7.4.38.20

15.38.s:
āsphoṭayaṃti pitaraḥ praharṣaṃti pitāmahāḥ ..
evaṃ taṃ svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śṛṇvānaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃbhavam .. 21 ..
15.38.d:
आस्फोटयंति पितरः प्रहर्षंति पितामहाः ॥
एवं तं स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा शृण्वानं कृष्णसंभवम् ॥ 21 ॥
15.38.m: The ancestors clap their hands, the grandfathers rejoice, / seeing their descendant thus listening to the origin of Kṛṣṇa. 21

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yatra no jāgare paṭhet ..
tanmlecchasadṛśaṃ sthānamapavitraṃ parityajet .. 22 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं यत्र नो जागरे पठेत् ॥
तन्म्लेच्छसदृशं स्थानमपवित्रं परित्यजेत् ॥ 22 ॥
15.38.m: Where the māhātmya of Dvārakā is not recited during the vigil, / that place is like a land of barbarians, impure; one should abandon it. 22

15.38.s:
śāligrāmaśilā naiva yatra bhāgavatā na hi ..
tyajettīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṇyamāyatanaṃ tyajet .. 23 ..
15.38.d:
शालिग्रामशिला नैव यत्र भागवता न हि ॥
त्यजेत्तीर्थं महापुण्यं पुण्यमायतनं त्यजेत् ॥ 23 ॥
15.38.m: Where there is no Śāligrāma stone, where there are indeed no devotees of Bhagavān, / one should abandon that sacred ford though highly meritorious, one should abandon that holy temple. 23

15.38.s: tyajedguhyaṃ tathā'raṇyaṃ yatra na dvādaśīvratam .. 24 ..
15.38.d: त्यजेद्गुह्यं तथाऽरण्यं यत्र न द्वादशीव्रतम् ॥ 24 ॥
15.38.m: Likewise, one should abandon a secret forest where the vow of the twelfth day is not observed. 24

15.38.s:
sudeśo'pi bhavenniṃdyo yatra no vaiṣṇavā vratam..
kudeśo'pi bhavetpuṇyo yatra bhāgavatāḥ kalau .. 25 ..
15.38.d:
सुदेशोऽपि भवेन्निंद्यो यत्र नो वैष्णवा व्रतम्॥
कुदेशोऽपि भवेत्पुण्यो यत्र भागवताः कलौ ॥ 25 ॥
15.38.m: Even a good region would become contemptible where Vaiṣṇavas perform no vow; / even a bad region would become holy where there are devotees of Bhagavān in the Kali age. 25

15.38.s:
saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ pūtā ye bhaktā madhusūdane ..
mlecchatulyāḥ kulīnāste ye na bhaktā janārdane.. 26 ..
15.38.d:
संकीर्णयोनयः पूता ये भक्ता मधुसूदने ॥
म्लेच्छतुल्याः कुलीनास्ते ये न भक्ता जनार्दने॥ 26 ॥
15.38.m: Those of mixed origins who are devoted to Madhusūdana are purified; / those of noble birth who are not devoted to Janārdana are equal to barbarians. 26

15.38.s:
rathārūḍhaṃ prakurvaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ madhumādhave ..
muktiṃ prayāṃti te sarve kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ .. 27 ..
15.38.d:
रथारूढं प्रकुर्वंति ये कृष्णं मधुमाधवे ॥
मुक्तिं प्रयांति ते सर्वे कुलकोटिसमन्विताः ॥ 27 ॥
15.38.m: Those who mount Kṛṣṇa upon a chariot in the spring months of Madhu and Mādhava, / they all attain liberation, accompanied by ten million ancestors of their lineage. 27

15.38.s:
devakīnandanasyārthe rathaṃ kārāpayanti ye ..
kalpāṃtaṃ viṣṇuloke te vasanti pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 28 ..
15.38.d:
देवकीनन्दनस्यार्थे रथं कारापयन्ति ये ॥
कल्पांतं विष्णुलोके ते वसन्ति पितृभिः सह ॥ 28 ॥
15.38.m: Those who cause a chariot to be made for the son of Devakī, / they dwell in the world of Viṣṇu until the end of the kalpa along with their ancestors. 28

15.38.s:
dvārakāyāstu māhātmyaṃ śrāvayedyaḥ kalau nṛṇām..
bhāvamutpādayedyo vai labhetkratuśataṃphalam .. 29 ..
15.38.d:
द्वारकायास्तु माहात्म्यं श्रावयेद्यः कलौ नृणाम्॥
भावमुत्पादयेद्यो वै लभेत्क्रतुशतंफलम् ॥ 29 ॥
15.38.m: He who recites the māhātmya of Dvārakā to men in the Kali age, / he who truly awakens devotion, obtains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices. 29

15.38.s:
yo nārcayati pāpiṣṭho devamanyatra gacchati ..
koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ harate rukmiṇīpatiḥ .. 7.4.38.30 ..
15.38.d:
यो नार्चयति पापिष्ठो देवमन्यत्र गच्छति ॥
कोटिजन्मार्जितं पुण्यं हरते रुक्मिणीपतिः ॥ 7.4.38.30 ॥
15.38.m: That worst of sinners who does not worship the god and goes elsewhere— / the husband of Rukmiṇī takes away the merit earned across ten million births. 7.4.38.30

15.38.s:
śaṃkhoddhārasamudbhūtāṃ nityaṃ dehe bibhartti hi ..
mṛttikāṃ daityarājendra śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yatphalam .. 31 ..
15.38.d:
शंखोद्धारसमुद्भूतां नित्यं देहे बिभर्त्ति हि ॥
मृत्तिकां दैत्यराजेन्द्र शृणु वक्ष्यामि यत्फलम् ॥ 31 ॥
15.38.m: He who constantly wears upon his body the clay / originating from Śaṅkhoddhāra—O king of Daityas, listen to the fruit of that, which I shall declare: 31

15.38.s:
yo dadāti yatīnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchati ..
svarṇabhāraśataṃ puṇḍraṃ nityaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 32 ..
15.38.d:
यो ददाति यतीनां च वैष्णवानां प्रयच्छति ॥
स्वर्णभारशतं पुण्ड्रं नित्यं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 32 ॥
15.38.m: He who gives it to ascetics and offers it to Vaiṣṇavas, / that man constantly attains the sectarian mark worth a hundred weights of gold. 32

15.38.s:
gṛhe yasya sadā tiṣṭhecchaṃkhoddhārasya mṛttikā ..
nitya kriyākṛtaṃpuṇyaṃ labhetkoṭiguṇaṃ bale .. 33 ..
15.38.d:
गृहे यस्य सदा तिष्ठेच्छंखोद्धारस्य मृत्तिका ॥
नित्य क्रियाकृतंपुण्यं लभेत्कोटिगुणं बले ॥ 33 ॥
15.38.m: In whose house the clay of Śaṅkhoddhāra constantly remains, / O Bali, he obtains ten million times the merit produced by daily rites. 33

15.38.s:
yasya puṇḍraṃ lalāṭe tu gopīcaṃdanasaṃjñakam ..
na jahāti gṛhaṃ tasya lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇapriyā dvijāḥ .. 34 ..
15.38.d:
यस्य पुण्ड्रं ललाटे तु गोपीचंदनसंज्ञकम् ॥
न जहाति गृहं तस्य लक्ष्मीः कृष्णप्रिया द्विजाः ॥ 34 ॥
15.38.m: Upon whose forehead is the mark known as gopīcandana, / Lakṣmī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, never abandons his house, O brahmins. 34

15.38.s:
na graho bādhate tasya norago na ca rākṣasaḥ ..
piśācā na ca kūṣmāṃḍā na ca pretā na jaṃbhakāḥ .. 35 ..
15.38.d:
न ग्रहो बाधते तस्य नोरगो न च राक्षसः ॥
पिशाचा न च कूष्मांडा न च प्रेता न जंभकाः ॥ 35 ॥
15.38.m: No planet torments him, nor serpent, nor rākṣasa, / no piśācas, nor kūṣmāṇḍas, nor pretas, nor jambhakas. 35

15.38.s:
nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tasya darīṇāṃ caiva bandhanam ..
vidyudulkābhayaṃ caiva na cotpātasamudbhavam .. 36 ..
15.38.d:
नाग्निचौरभयं तस्य दरीणां चैव बन्धनम् ॥
विद्युदुल्काभयं चैव न चोत्पातसमुद्भवम् ॥ 36 ॥
15.38.m: He has no fear of fire or thieves, nor imprisonment in caves, / nor fear of lightning and meteors, nor that arising from portents. 36

15.38.s:
nāriṣṭaṃ nāpaśakunaṃ durnimittādikaṃ ca yat ..
satkṛte viṣṇubhakte ca śāligrāmaśilārcane .. 37 ..
15.38.d:
नारिष्टं नापशकुनं दुर्निमित्तादिकं च यत् ॥
सत्कृते विष्णुभक्ते च शालिग्रामशिलार्चने ॥ 37 ॥
15.38.m: No misfortune, no ill omen, whatever inauspicious signs there may be, [afflicts him], / when the devotee of Viṣṇu is honored, and worship of the Śāligrāma stone is performed, 37

15.38.s:
pīte pādodake viprā naivedyasyāpi bhakṣaṇe ..
tulasīsannidhau viṣṇorvilayāvasare kṛte .. 38 ..
15.38.d:
पीते पादोदके विप्रा नैवेद्यस्यापि भक्षणे ॥
तुलसीसन्निधौ विष्णोर्विलयावसरे कृते ॥ 38 ॥
15.38.m: when the water of [the Lord's] feet has been drunk, O brahmins, and the food offering eaten, / [and] when departure is made in the presence of Viṣṇu's tulasī plant. 38

15.38.s:
purā devena kathitaṃ śṛṇu pātraṃ vadāmyaham ..
priyā bhāgavatā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāso'smyahaṃ sadā .. 39..
15.38.d:
पुरा देवेन कथितं शृणु पात्रं वदाम्यहम् ॥
प्रिया भागवता येषां तेषां दासोऽस्म्यहं सदा ॥ 39॥
15.38.m: Formerly it was spoken by the God; hear, I shall declare the worthy recipient: / 'To those to whom the devotees of Bhagavān are dear, I am always their servant. 39

15.38.s:
vihāya mathurāṃ kāśīmavantīṃ sarvapāpahām ..
māyāṃ kāṃcīmayodhyāṃ ca saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge .. .. 7.4.38.40 ..
15.38.d:
विहाय मथुरां काशीमवन्तीं सर्वपापहाम् ॥
मायां कांचीमयोध्यां च संप्राप्ते च कलौ युगे ॥ ॥ 7.4.38.40 ॥
15.38.m: Abandoning Mathurā, Kāśī, and Avantī which destroys all sin, / Māyā, Kāñcī, and Ayodhyā, when the Kali age has arrived, 7.4.38.40

15.38.s:
vasāmyahaṃ dvārakāyāṃ sarvasenāsamāvṛtaḥ ..
tīrthavratairyajñadānai rudrādyairmunicāraṇaiḥ .. 41 ..
15.38.d:
वसाम्यहं द्वारकायां सर्वसेनासमावृतः ॥
तीर्थव्रतैर्यज्ञदानै रुद्राद्यैर्मुनिचारणैः ॥ 41 ॥
15.38.m: surrounded by all armies, I dwell in Dvārakā / along with Rudra and others, sages, and cāraṇas, through sacred fords, vows, sacrifices, and gifts. 41

15.38.s:
śraddhātyāgena bhaktyā vā yastoṣayitumicchati ..
gatvā dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ draṣṭavyo'haṃ kalau yuge .. 42 ..
15.38.d:
श्रद्धात्यागेन भक्त्या वा यस्तोषयितुमिच्छति ॥
गत्वा द्वारवतीं रम्यां द्रष्टव्योऽहं कलौ युगे ॥ 42 ॥
15.38.m: Whoever desires to please me with faith, renunciation, or devotion, / must go to delightful Dvāravatī and behold me in the Kali age. 42

15.38.s:
trailokye yāni tīrthāni mayā śuddhāni bhūriśaḥ ...
vinyastāni ca gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe'tipāvane .. 43 ..
15.38.d:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि तीर्थानि मया शुद्धानि भूरिशः ॥।
विन्यस्तानि च गोमत्यां चक्रतीर्थेऽतिपावने ॥ 43 ॥
15.38.m: Whatever sacred fords are in the three worlds have in abundance / been purified and deposited by me in the Gomatī and at the extremely sacred Cakratīrtha. 43

15.38.s:
dinenaikena gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe kalau yuge ..
trailokyasaṃbhavaistīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ .. 44 ..
15.38.d:
दिनेनैकेन गोमत्यां चक्रतीर्थे कलौ युगे ॥
त्रैलोक्यसंभवैस्तीर्थैः स्नातो भवति मानवः ॥ 44 ॥
15.38.m: In a single day in the Gomatī, at Cakratīrtha in the Kali age, / a mortal becomes one who has bathed in the sacred fords belonging to the three worlds. 44

15.38.s:
koṭipāpavinirmukto matsamaṃ vasate naraḥ ..
mama loke na saṃdehaḥ kulakoṭisamanvitaḥ .. 45 ..
15.38.d:
कोटिपापविनिर्मुक्तो मत्समं वसते नरः ॥
मम लोके न संदेहः कुलकोटिसमन्वितः ॥ 45 ॥
15.38.m: Freed from ten million sins, a man dwells equal to me / in my world without doubt, accompanied by ten million members of his lineage. 45

15.38.s:
nāparādhakṛtaiḥ pāpairliptaḥ syādu tkaṭaiḥ kṛtaiḥ ..
śatajanmāyutānīha lakṣmīrna cyavate gṛhāt .. 46 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatītīragata dvārakācakratīrthayorjāgarādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ-nāmāṣṭātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 38 ..
15.38.d:
नापराधकृतैः पापैर्लिप्तः स्यादु त्कटैः कृतैः ॥
शतजन्मायुतानीह लक्ष्मीर्न च्यवते गृहात् ॥ 46 ॥
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमतीतीरगत द्वारकाचक्रतीर्थयोर्जागरादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं-नामाष्टात्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः ॥ 38 ॥
15.38.m:
He would not be stained by sins committed through severe transgressions, / and for ten thousand hundreds of births Lakṣmī does not fall away from his home.' 46
Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of the Vigil and Other Rites at Dvārakā and Cakratīrtha on the Banks of the Gomatī' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [subdivision] of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of Skanda consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 38

15.39.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī ..
unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī .. 1 ..
15.39.d:
॥ श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
जया च विजया चैव जयंती पापनाशिनी ॥
उन्मीलिनी वंजुली च त्रिस्पृशा पक्षवर्द्धिनी ॥ 1 ॥
15.39.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Jayā, Vijayā, and Jayantī, destroying sin, / Unmīlinī, Vañjulī, and Trispṛśā, Pakṣavardhinī— 1

15.39.s:
puṇyaṃ sarvapurāṇānāṃ te labhaṃte dinedine ..
pakvānnaṃ ye prakurvaṃti havirddhānyasamudbhavam .. 2 ..
15.39.d:
पुण्यं सर्वपुराणानां ते लभंते दिनेदिने ॥
पक्वान्नं ये प्रकुर्वंति हविर्द्धान्यसमुद्भवम् ॥ 2 ॥
15.39.m: those who prepare cooked food made from sacrificial grain / obtain day by day the merit of all the Purāṇas. 2

15.39.s:
jāgare padmanābhasya ghṛtenaiva supācitam ..
vartidvayasamāyuktaṃ dīpaṃ ghṛtasamanvitam .. 3 ..
15.39.d:
जागरे पद्मनाभस्य घृतेनैव सुपाचितम् ॥
वर्तिद्वयसमायुक्तं दीपं घृतसमन्वितम् ॥ 3 ॥
15.39.m: He who during the vigil of the Lotus-navel [Lord offers food] well-cooked with ghee, / and a lamp furnished with two wicks and filled with ghee, 3

15.39.s:
yaḥ kuryyājjāgare viṣṇoḥ śāligrāmaśilāgrataḥ ..
śālagrāmaśilāgre tu ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram .. 4 ..
15.39.d:
यः कुर्य्याज्जागरे विष्णोः शालिग्रामशिलाग्रतः ॥
शालग्रामशिलाग्रे तु ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् ॥ 4 ॥
15.39.m: who offers this during the vigil of Viṣṇu before a Śāligrāma stone— / indeed, those who perform the vigil in front of a Śāligrāma stone, 4

15.39.s:
kurvaṃti nṛtyavādye ca lokānāṃ raṃjanāya ca ..
saṃchādayaṃti kusumaiḥ śāligrāmaśilāṃ ca ye .. 5 ..
15.39.d:
कुर्वंति नृत्यवाद्ये च लोकानां रंजनाय च ॥
संछादयंति कुसुमैः शालिग्रामशिलां च ये ॥ 5 ॥
15.39.m: who perform dance and instrumental music for the delight of the people, / and who cover the Śāligrāma stone with flowers, 5

15.39.s:
cakrāṃkitāṃ viśeṣeṇa pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dvijāḥ ..
caṃdanaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ kṛṣṇāgurusamanvitam .. 6 ..
15.39.d:
चक्रांकितां विशेषेण प्रतिमां वैष्णवीं द्विजाः ॥
चंदनं च सकर्पूरं कृष्णागुरुसमन्वितम् ॥ 6 ॥
15.39.m: especially the image of Viṣṇu marked with a discus, O brahmins, / and who applies an unguent of sandalwood along with camphor and black agallochum, 6

15.39.s:
yuktaṃ mṛgamadenāpi yaḥ karoti vilepanam ..
dvādaśyāṃ devadevasya rātrau jāgaraṇe sadā .. 7 ..
15.39.d:
युक्तं मृगमदेनापि यः करोति विलेपनम् ॥
द्वादश्यां देवदेवस्य रात्रौ जागरणे सदा ॥ 7 ॥
15.39.m: mixed also with musk, / during the nightly vigil for the God of gods always on the twelfth day, 7

15.39.s:
tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa ca vo'grataḥ ..
tatphalaṃ koṭitīrthe tu ujjayinyāṃ mahālaye .. 8 ..
15.39.d:
तस्य पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपेण च वोऽग्रतः ॥
तत्फलं कोटितीर्थे तु उज्जयिन्यां महालये ॥ 8 ॥
15.39.m: I shall declare before you in brief his merit: / That fruit [is identical to that obtained] at Koṭitīrtha, in Ujjayinī, at Mahālaya, 8

15.39.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre mathurāyāṃ tripuṣkare ..
ayodhyāyāṃ prayāge ca tīrthe sāgarasaṃgame .. 9 ..
15.39.d:
वाराणस्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे मथुरायां त्रिपुष्करे ॥
अयोध्यायां प्रयागे च तीर्थे सागरसंगमे ॥ 9 ॥
15.39.m: in Vārāṇasī, in Kurukṣetra, in Mathurā, at Tripuṣkara, / in Ayodhyā, and at Prayāga, and at the sacred ford at the confluence of the ocean. 9

15.39.s:
sarvapuṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
kṛtairyajñāyutaistatra vratadānaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .. 7.4.39.10 ..
15.39.d:
सर्वपुण्येषु तीर्थेषु देवतायतनेषु च ॥
कृतैर्यज्ञायुतैस्तत्र व्रतदानैश्च पुष्कलैः ॥ 7.4.39.10 ॥
15.39.m: In all sacred tirthas and shrines of the deities, / by means of ten thousand sacrifices performed there, and abundant vows and gifts;

15.39.s:
vedairadhītairyatpuṇyaṃ purāṇaiścāvagāhitaiḥ ..
tapobhiścaritaiḥ puṇyaṃ samyagāśrama pālanaiḥ .. 11 ..
15.39.d:
वेदैरधीतैर्यत्पुण्यं पुराणैश्चावगाहितैः ॥
तपोभिश्चरितैः पुण्यं सम्यगाश्रम पालनैः ॥ 11 ॥
15.39.m: whatever merit comes from studying the Vedas and delving into the Purāṇas, / the merit from austerities practiced and the proper observance of life stages;

15.39.s:
yatphalaṃ munibhiḥ proktaṃ vedavyāsena putraka ..
tatphalaṃ jāgare viṣṇoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ .. 12 ..
15.39.d:
यत्फलं मुनिभिः प्रोक्तं वेदव्यासेन पुत्रक ॥
तत्फलं जागरे विष्णोः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः ॥ 12 ॥
15.39.m: the fruit declared by the sages and by Vedavyāsa, O son, / that very fruit is gained by keeping vigil for Viṣṇu during both the light and dark fortnights.

15.39.s:
haimavatyai purā proktaṃ kailāse śūlapāṇinā ..
nāradāya purā proktaṃ brahmaṇā matsamīpataḥ .. 13 ..
15.39.d:
हैमवत्यै पुरा प्रोक्तं कैलासे शूलपाणिना ॥
नारदाय पुरा प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा मत्समीपतः ॥ 13 ॥
15.39.m: In former times it was told by the trident-bearer on Kailāsa to Haimavatī; / it was told of old to Nārada by Brahmā in my presence;

15.39.s:
aruṇena vajrahastāya kathitaṃ pṛcchate purā ..
dvādaśījāgarasyoktaṃ phalaṃ viprā mayā ca vaḥ..
tatkurudhvaṃ dvijā yūyaṃ jāgaraṃ viṣṇuvāsare .. 14 ..
15.39.d:
अरुणेन वज्रहस्ताय कथितं पृच्छते पुरा ॥
द्वादशीजागरस्योक्तं फलं विप्रा मया च वः॥
तत्कुरुध्वं द्विजा यूयं जागरं विष्णुवासरे ॥ 14 ॥
15.39.m: and formerly it was narrated by Aruṇa to [Indra], wielder of the thunderbolt, who had questioned him. / Thus the fruit of keeping vigil on the twelfth lunar day has been told by me to you, O brahmins; / therefore, O twice-born, do observe the vigil on the day of Viṣṇu.

15.39.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā brāhmaṇānprāha baliṃ pautraṃ svakaṃ tataḥ ..
tvamapi śraddhayā pautra kuru jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ .. 15 ..
15.39.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणान्प्राह बलिं पौत्रं स्वकं ततः ॥
त्वमपि श्रद्धया पौत्र कुरु जागरणं हरेः ॥ 15 ॥
15.39.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to the brahmins, he then addressed his grandson Bali: / "You too, grandson, with faith observe the night-vigil of Hari.

15.39.s:
dvārakā manasā dhyātā pāpaṃ varṣaśatānvitam ..
kīrtanācchatajanmotthaṃ dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 16 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारका मनसा ध्याता पापं वर्षशतान्वितम् ॥
कीर्तनाच्छतजन्मोत्थं दहते नात्र संशयः ॥ 16 ॥
15.39.m: When contemplated with the mind, Dvārakā burns away sin gathered over a hundred years; / through singing its praise, it burns [sin] born of a hundred lifetimes—there is no doubt about this.

15.39.s:
pāpaṃ janmasahasrotthaṃ padamātreṇa gacchatām ..
dvārakā harate nūnaṃ muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya darśanāt .. 17 ..
15.39.d:
पापं जन्मसहस्रोत्थं पदमात्रेण गच्छताम् ॥
द्वारका हरते नूनं मुक्तिः कृष्णस्य दर्शनात् ॥ 17 ॥
15.39.m: Sin arising from a thousand lifetimes, for those who merely step forward on foot, / Dvārakā truly takes away; liberation comes from the sight of Kṛṣṇa.

15.39.s:
na śaknoti yadā gaṃtuṃ dvārakāṃ caiva mānavaḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ gṛhe .. 18 ..
15.39.d:
न शक्नोति यदा गंतुं द्वारकां चैव मानवः ॥
माहात्म्यं पठनीयं तु द्वारकासंभवं गृहे ॥ 18 ॥
15.39.m: When a man is unable to go to Dvārakā, / the māhātmya relating to Dvārakā should certainly be recited in his house.

15.39.s:
dātavyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śrotavyaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ ..
dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa paṭhanīyaṃ tu jāgare .. 19 ..
15.39.d:
दातव्यं वैष्णवानां तु श्रोतव्यं भक्तिभावतः ॥
द्वादश्यां च विशेषेण पठनीयं तु जागरे ॥ 19 ॥
15.39.m: It should be given to Vaiṣṇavas and heard with devoted feeling; / and it should especially be recited on the twelfth lunar day during the night-vigil.

15.39.s:
dvārakā saṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ sa saṃprāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
prasādādvāsudevasya satyaṃsatyaṃ ca bhāṣitam .. 7.4.39.20 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारका संभवं पुण्यं स संप्राप्नोति मानवः ॥
प्रसादाद्वासुदेवस्य सत्यंसत्यं च भाषितम् ॥ 7.4.39.20 ॥
15.39.m: That man obtains the merit that arises from Dvārakā / by the grace of Vāsudeva; this is spoken as truth upon truth.

15.39.s:
gṛhe saṃtiṣṭhate nityaṃ mathurā dvārakā tathā ..
avaṃtī ca tathā māyā prayāgaṃ kurujāṃgalam .. 21 ..
15.39.d:
गृहे संतिष्ठते नित्यं मथुरा द्वारका तथा ॥
अवंती च तथा माया प्रयागं कुरुजांगलम् ॥ 21 ॥
15.39.m: In his house there abide continually Mathurā, likewise Dvārakā, / Avantī, and also Māyā, Prayāga, and Kurujāṅgala;

15.39.s:
tripuṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ ca gaṃgādvāraṃ ca saukaram ..
caṃdreśaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudramahālayam .. 22 ..
15.39.d:
त्रिपुष्करं नैमिषं च गंगाद्वारं च सौकरम् ॥
चंद्रेशं चैव केदारं तथा रुद्रमहालयम् ॥ 22 ॥
15.39.m: Tripuṣkara, Naimiṣa, Gaṅgādvāra, and Saukara, / Candreśa, Kedāra, and Rudramahālaya;

15.39.s:
vastrāpathaṃ mahādevaṃ mahākālaṃ tathaiva ca ..
bhūteśvaraṃ bhasmagātraṃ somanāthamumāpatim.. 23 ..
15.39.d:
वस्त्रापथं महादेवं महाकालं तथैव च ॥
भूतेश्वरं भस्मगात्रं सोमनाथमुमापतिम्॥ 23 ॥
15.39.m: Vastrāpatha, Mahādeva, Mahākāla as well, / Bhūteśvara, Bhasmagātra, Somanātha, the lord of Umā;

15.39.s:
koṭiliṃgaṃ trinetraṃ ca devaṃ bhṛguvanecaram ..
dīpeśvaraṃ mahānādaṃ devaṃ caivācaleśvaram .. 24 ..
15.39.d:
कोटिलिंगं त्रिनेत्रं च देवं भृगुवनेचरम् ॥
दीपेश्वरं महानादं देवं चैवाचलेश्वरम् ॥ 24 ॥
15.39.m: Koṭiliṅga, Trinetra, the god who ranges the Bhṛgu forest, / Dīpeśvara, Mahānāda, and the god Acaleśvara.

15.39.s:
brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā gṛhe tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā ..
pitaro nāgagaṃdharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ .. 25 ..
15.39.d:
ब्रह्मादयः सुरगणा गृहे तिष्ठंति सर्वदा ॥
पितरो नागगंधर्वा मुनयः सिद्धचारणाः ॥ 25 ॥
15.39.m: Brahmā and the hosts of gods always reside in his house, / as do the ancestors, Nāgas, Gandharvas, sages, Siddhas, and Cāraṇas.

15.39.s:
tīrthāni yāni kāni syuraśvamedhādayo makhāḥ ..
kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ pautra yaḥ karoti viśeṣataḥ .. 26 ..
15.39.d:
तीर्थानि यानि कानि स्युरश्वमेधादयो मखाः ॥
कृष्णजन्माष्टमीं पौत्र यः करोति विशेषतः ॥ 26 ॥
15.39.m: Whatever sacred tirthas there may be, or sacrifices like the horse-sacrifice— / [all these belong to him,] O grandson, who especially observes the eighth day of Kṛṣṇa's birth.

15.39.s:
yathā bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ tathā bhāgavato naraḥ ..
ubhayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti haraharyostathaiva ca .. 27 ..
15.39.d:
यथा भागवतं शास्त्रं तथा भागवतो नरः ॥
उभयोरंतरं नास्ति हरहर्योस्तथैव च ॥ 27 ॥
15.39.m: As is the Bhāgavata scripture, so is the man who is a devotee of the Lord; / between the two there is no distinction, just as between Hara and Hari.

15.39.s:
nīlīkṣetraṃ tu yo yāti mūlakaṃ bhakṣayettu yaḥ ..
naivāsti narakoddhāraṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 28 ..
15.39.d:
नीलीक्षेत्रं तु यो याति मूलकं भक्षयेत्तु यः ॥
नैवास्ति नरकोद्धारं कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ॥ 28 ॥
15.39.m: He who enters an indigo field, or he who eats a radish, / has no deliverance from hell even through hundreds of millions of eons.

15.39.s:
nīlīkarma tu yaḥ kuryyādbrāhmaṇo lobhamohitaḥ ..
nāpnoti sukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkuryyādvā rasavikrayam .. 29 ..
15.39.d:
नीलीकर्म तु यः कुर्य्याद्ब्राह्मणो लोभमोहितः ॥
नाप्नोति सुकृतं किंचित्कुर्य्याद्वा रसविक्रयम् ॥ 29 ॥
15.39.m: A brahmin deluded by greed who engages in the indigo trade, / or sells juices, does not attain any good deed.

15.39.s:
prasīdati na viśvātmā vaiṣṇave cāpamānite ..
aśvatthaṃ chedayedyo vai ekaikasmiṃśca parvaṇi .. 7.4.39.30 ..
15.39.d:
प्रसीदति न विश्वात्मा वैष्णवे चापमानिते ॥
अश्वत्थं छेदयेद्यो वै एकैकस्मिंश्च पर्वणि ॥ 7.4.39.30 ॥
15.39.m: The Soul of the Universe is never pleased when a Vaiṣṇava is insulted; / and he who cuts down an aśvattha tree on every sacred occasion

15.39.s:
manvaṃtarāṇi tāvaṃti raurave vasatirbhavet ..
ariṣṭakāṣṭhairdaityeṃdra kāryyaṃ yaḥ kurute kvacit ..
na pūjāmarghadānaṃ ca tasya gṛhṇāti bhāskaraḥ .. 31 ..
15.39.d:
मन्वंतराणि तावंति रौरवे वसतिर्भवेत् ॥
अरिष्टकाष्ठैर्दैत्येंद्र कार्य्यं यः कुरुते क्वचित् ॥
न पूजामर्घदानं च तस्य गृह्णाति भास्करः ॥ 31 ॥
15.39.m: shall dwell in Raurava hell for that many manvantaras. / If anyone ever makes an object using ariṣṭa wood, O king of the Daityas, / the Sun does not accept his worship or offering of water.

15.39.s:
chedāpakasya cārke tu cchedakasya ca daityaja ..
śataṃ janmāni dāridyaṃ jāyate ca sarogatā .. 32 ..
15.39.d:
छेदापकस्य चार्के तु च्छेदकस्य च दैत्यज ॥
शतं जन्मानि दारिद्यं जायते च सरोगता ॥ 32 ॥
15.39.m: For the one who causes an arka tree to be cut, and for the one who cuts it, O born of the Daityas, / poverty and disease arise for a hundred lifetimes.

15.39.s:
ropayetpālayedyo vai sūryyavṛkṣaṃ narottamaḥ ..
saptakalpaṃ vasetso'tra samīpe bhāskarasya hi .. 33 ..
15.39.d:
रोपयेत्पालयेद्यो वै सूर्य्यवृक्षं नरोत्तमः ॥
सप्तकल्पं वसेत्सोऽत्र समीपे भास्करस्य हि ॥ 33 ॥
15.39.m: The best among men who plants and protects a sun-tree / shall dwell there near the Sun for seven eons.

15.39.s:
ropitairdevavṛkṣaistu yatphalaṃ lakṣakoṭibhiḥ ..
nyagrodhavṛkṣeṇaikena ropitena phalaṃ hi tat .. 34 ..
15.39.d:
रोपितैर्देववृक्षैस्तु यत्फलं लक्षकोटिभिः ॥
न्यग्रोधवृक्षेणैकेन रोपितेन फलं हि तत् ॥ 34 ॥
15.39.m: Whatever fruit comes from planting hundreds of thousands and millions of divine trees, / that very fruit is attained by planting a single banyan tree.

15.39.s:
dhātrīdrume'pyevameva phalaṃ bhavati ropite ..
tulasīropaṇe caiva adhikaṃ cāpi suvrata ..
amaratvaṃ ca te yāṃti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā .. 35 ..
15.39.d:
धात्रीद्रुमेऽप्येवमेव फलं भवति रोपिते ॥
तुलसीरोपणे चैव अधिकं चापि सुव्रत ॥
अमरत्वं च ते यांति नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा ॥ 35 ॥
15.39.m: In the same way there is fruit when an myrobalan tree is planted; / and even greater, O one of good vows, when tulasī is planted; / and they attain immortality—no doubt should be entertained here.

15.39.s:
dvārakāṃ kalikāle tu prātarutthāya kīrtayet ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ svargaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ .. 36 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारकां कलिकाले तु प्रातरुत्थाय कीर्तयेत् ॥
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गं याति न संशयः ॥ 36 ॥
15.39.m: One who rises in the morning in the Kali age and proclaims [the name of] Dvārakā, / freed from all sins, goes to heaven—there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
rohiṇīsahitā ye na dvādaśī samupoṣitā ..
mahāpātakasaṃyuktaḥ kalpāṃte nākamāpnuyāt .. 37 ..
15.39.d:
रोहिणीसहिता ये न द्वादशी समुपोषिता ॥
महापातकसंयुक्तः कल्पांते नाकमाप्नुयात् ॥ 37 ॥
15.39.m: By whom the twelfth lunar day combined with Rohiṇī is fasted, / even if burdened with great sins, he attains heaven at the end of the eon.

15.39.s:
vāsaraḥ ko vinā sūryyaṃ vinā somena kā niśā ..
vinā vṛkṣeṇa ko grāmo dvādaśī kiṃ vrataṃ vinā .. 38 ..
15.39.d:
वासरः को विना सूर्य्यं विना सोमेन का निशा ॥
विना वृक्षेण को ग्रामो द्वादशी किं व्रतं विना ॥ 38 ॥
15.39.m: What is a day without the sun? What is a night without the moon? / What is a village without a tree? What is a twelfth lunar day without a vow?

15.39.s:
gṛhaṃ ca narakaṃ tasya yamadaṇḍaṃ dvitīyakam ..
na yatra paṭhate nityaṃ viṣṇornāmasahasrakam .. 39 ..
15.39.d:
गृहं च नरकं तस्य यमदण्डं द्वितीयकम् ॥
न यत्र पठते नित्यं विष्णोर्नामसहस्रकम् ॥ 39 ॥
15.39.m: His house is a hell and a second punishment of Yama, / where the Thousand Names of Viṣṇu are not recited daily.

15.39.s:
narakaṃ ca bhavettasya dvitīyaṃ yamaśāsanam ..
naiva bhāgavataṃ yatra purāṇaṃ gīyate kalau ..
andhakūpeṣu kṣipyaṃte jvaliteṣu hutāśane .. 7.4.39.40 ..
15.39.d:
नरकं च भवेत्तस्य द्वितीयं यमशासनम् ॥
नैव भागवतं यत्र पुराणं गीयते कलौ ॥
अन्धकूपेषु क्षिप्यंते ज्वलितेषु हुताशने ॥ 7.4.39.40 ॥
15.39.m: It becomes a hell for him, a second decree of Yama, / where the Bhāgavata Purāṇa is not sung in the Kali age; / [such people] are cast into blinded wells blazing with fire.

15.39.s:
dviṣaṃti ye bhāgavataṃ na kurvaṃti dinaṃ hareḥ ..
yamadūtaiśca nīyante tathā bhūmau bhavaṃti te .. 41 ..
15.39.d:
द्विषंति ये भागवतं न कुर्वंति दिनं हरेः ॥
यमदूतैश्च नीयन्ते तथा भूमौ भवंति ते ॥ 41 ॥
15.39.m: Those who hate the Bhāgavata and do not observe the day of Hari, / are carried off by Yama's messengers, and thus they remain upon the earth [in misery].

15.39.s:
vācyamānaṃ na śṛṇvaṃti hareścaritamuttamam ..
karapatraiśca pīḍyaṃte sutīvrairyama śāsanāt.. 42 ..
15.39.d:
वाच्यमानं न शृण्वंति हरेश्चरितमुत्तमम् ॥
करपत्रैश्च पीड्यंते सुतीव्रैर्यम शासनात्॥ 42 ॥
15.39.m: Those who do not listen to the excellent deeds of Hari being recited / are tormented with extremely sharp saws by the decree of Yama.

15.39.s:
nindāṃ kurvaṃti ye pāpā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām ..
teṣāṃ nirayapātastu yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 43 ..
15.39.d:
निन्दां कुर्वंति ये पापा वैष्णवानां महात्मनाम् ॥
तेषां निरयपातस्तु यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 43 ॥
15.39.m: Those sinners who insult noble Vaiṣṇavas / suffer a fall into hell that lasts until the cosmic dissolution.

15.39.s:
gokoṭitīrthādadhikaṃ snānaṃ tatrādhikaṃ bhavet ..
ye paśyaṃti mahāpuṇyā gopīcaṃdanamṛttikām..
gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 44 ..
15.39.d:
गोकोटितीर्थादधिकं स्नानं तत्राधिकं भवेत् ॥
ये पश्यंति महापुण्या गोपीचंदनमृत्तिकाम्॥
गंगास्नानफलं तेषां जायते नात्र संशयः ॥ 44 ॥
15.39.m: The ablution there becomes greater than at a sacred ford of ten million cows; / those highly meritorious people who see the gopīcandana clay— / for them the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā arises, there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchaṃti gopīcaṃ danamṛttikām ..
yeṣāṃ lalāṭe tilakaḥ gopīcaṃdanasaṃbhavam.. 45 ..
15.39.d:
वैष्णवानां प्रयच्छंति गोपीचं दनमृत्तिकाम् ॥
येषां ललाटे तिलकः गोपीचंदनसंभवम्॥ 45 ॥
15.39.m: They give gopīcandana clay to Vaiṣṇavas; / those on whose forehead is the tilaka made of gopīcandana,

15.39.s:
gopīcaṃdanapuṃḍreṇa dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte ..
viṣṇornāmasahasrasya pāṭhena muktimāpnuyāt .. 46 ..
15.39.d:
गोपीचंदनपुंड्रेण द्वादश्यां जागरे कृते ॥
विष्णोर्नामसहस्रस्य पाठेन मुक्तिमाप्नुयात् ॥ 46 ॥
15.39.m: having applied the vertical mark with gopīcandana and kept vigil on the twelfth lunar day, / attain liberation through reciting the Thousand Names of Viṣṇu.

15.39.s:
ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu kīrtanam..
gomatīsmaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ kṛṣṇatulyā na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
15.39.d:
ये नित्यं प्रातरुत्थाय वैष्णवानां तु कीर्तनम्॥
गोमतीस्मरणं कुर्युः कृष्णतुल्या न संशयः ॥ 47 ॥
15.39.m: Those who, rising daily in the morning, praise the Vaiṣṇavas / and remember the Gomatī, are equal to Kṛṣṇa—there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya dvāraketi vadaṃti ca ..
tīrthakoṭibhavaṃ puṇyaṃ labhaṃte ca dinedine .. 48 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśīvratādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 39 ..
15.39.d:
ये नित्यं प्रातरुत्थाय द्वारकेति वदंति च ॥
तीर्थकोटिभवं पुण्यं लभंते च दिनेदिने ॥ 48 ॥
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वादशीव्रतादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः ॥ 39 ॥
15.39.m:
Those who, rising daily in the morning, say "Dvārakā", / obtain day by day the merit arising from ten million sacred fords.
Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of the Twelfth Lunar Day Vow and Other Rites," in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

15.40.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
svanāmāṃkita patraistu śrīpatiṃ yo'rcayeta vai ..
saptalokānanuprāpya saptadvīpādhipo bhavet.. 1 ..
15.40.d:
॥ श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
स्वनामांकित पत्रैस्तु श्रीपतिं योऽर्चयेत वै ॥
सप्तलोकाननुप्राप्य सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत्॥ 1 ॥
15.40.m: Śrī Prahlāda said: / One who worships the Lord of Śrī with leaves marked with his own name, / having attained the seven worlds, becomes the lord of the seven continents.

15.40.s:
mākāntavṛkṣapatraistu yo'rcayeta sadā harim ..
puṇyaṃ bhavati tasyeha vājimedhāyutaṃ kalau .. 2 ..
15.40.d:
माकान्तवृक्षपत्रैस्तु योऽर्चयेत सदा हरिम् ॥
पुण्यं भवति तस्येह वाजिमेधायुतं कलौ ॥ 2 ॥
15.40.m: One who always worships Hari with the leaves of the mākānta tree / gains the merit in this Kali age of ten thousand horse sacrifices.

15.40.s:
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ devīṃ sāvitrīṃ caṃḍikāṃ tathā ..
pūjayitvā divaṃ yāti patraiḥ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 3 ..
15.40.d:
लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीं देवीं सावित्रीं चंडिकां तथा ॥
पूजयित्वा दिवं याति पत्रैः श्रीवृक्षसंभवैः ॥ 3 ॥
15.40.m: Having worshipped Lakṣmī, the goddess Sarasvatī, Sāvitrī, and Caṇḍikā / with leaves produced from the bilva tree, he goes to heaven.

15.40.s:
tulasyā adhikaṃ proktaṃ dalaṃ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavam..
tasmānnityaṃ prayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadā'cyutaḥ .. 4 ..
15.40.d:
तुलस्या अधिकं प्रोक्तं दलं श्रीवृक्षसंभवम्॥
तस्मान्नित्यं प्रयत्नेन पूजनीयः सदाऽच्युतः ॥ 4 ॥
15.40.m: A leaf produced from the bilva tree is declared superior to tulasī; / therefore, Acyuta should always be worshipped with effort.

15.40.s:
dvādaśyāṃ ravivāreṇa śrīvṛkṣamarcayanti ye ..
brahmahatyādikaiḥ pāpairna lipyaṃte kṛtairapi .. 5 ..
15.40.d:
द्वादश्यां रविवारेण श्रीवृक्षमर्चयन्ति ये ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादिकैः पापैर्न लिप्यंते कृतैरपि ॥ 5 ॥
15.40.m: Those who worship the bilva tree on a Dvādaśī that falls on a Sunday / are not tainted even by sins committed such as the killing of a brahmin.

15.40.s:
yathā karipade'nyāni praviśaṃti padāni ca ..
tathā sarvāṇi puṇyāni praviṣṭāni harerdine .. 6 ..
15.40.d:
यथा करिपदेऽन्यानि प्रविशंति पदानि च ॥
तथा सर्वाणि पुण्यानि प्रविष्टानि हरेर्दिने ॥ 6 ॥
15.40.m: Just as other footprints enter into an elephant's footprint, / so all merits are entered into Hari's day.

15.40.s:
adhruveṇaiva dehena pratikṣa ṇavināśinā ..
kathaṃ nopāsate jaṃturdvādaśīṃ jāgarānvitām .. 7 ..
15.40.d:
अध्रुवेणैव देहेन प्रतिक्ष णविनाशिना ॥
कथं नोपासते जंतुर्द्वादशीं जागरान्विताम् ॥ 7 ॥
15.40.m: With an impermanent body that is destroyed at every moment, / why does a living being not observe the Dvādaśī accompanied by a vigil?

15.40.s:
atītānpuruṣānsapta bhaviṣyāṃśca caturddaśa ..
narakāttārayetsarvām̐llokānkṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt ..
na te jīvaṃti loke'sminyatratatra sthitā narāḥ .. 8 ..
15.40.d:
अतीतान्पुरुषान्सप्त भविष्यांश्च चतुर्द्दश ॥
नरकात्तारयेत्सर्वाम्̐ल्लोकान्कृष्णेति कीर्तनात् ॥
न ते जीवंति लोकेऽस्मिन्यत्रतत्र स्थिता नराः ॥ 8 ॥
15.40.m: From chanting 'Kṛṣṇa', one delivers all people from hell— / seven ancestors and fourteen descendants. / Men residing anywhere do not truly live in this world [without it].

15.40.s:
dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu vaṃditāḥ..
dvārakāyāṃ prakurvaṃti yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ sthitim ..
grāsegrāse makhaśataṃ te labhaṃte phalaṃ narāḥ ..9 ..
15.40.d:
द्वारकायां च संप्राप्तास्त्रिषु लोकेषु वंदिताः॥
द्वारकायां प्रकुर्वंति यतीनां भोजनं स्थितिम् ॥
ग्रासेग्रासे मखशतं ते लभंते फलं नराः ॥9 ॥
15.40.m: And when they reach Dvārakā, they are praised in the three worlds. / Men who provide food and lodging for ascetics in Dvārakā / obtain the reward of a hundred sacrifices at every mouthful.

15.40.s:
yatīnāṃ ye prayacchaṃti kaupīnācchādanādikam ..
vasatāṃ dvārakāmadhye yathāśaktyā tu bhojanam ..
śṛṇu puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsena hi daityaja .. 7.4.40.10 ..
15.40.d:
यतीनां ये प्रयच्छंति कौपीनाच्छादनादिकम् ॥
वसतां द्वारकामध्ये यथाशक्त्या तु भोजनम् ॥
शृणु पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन हि दैत्यज ॥ 7.4.40.10 ॥
15.40.m: Those who give loincloths, garments, and the like to ascetics, / and food according to their capacity to those living within Dvārakā— / hear, O son of Daitya, I shall declare the merit in brief.

15.40.s:
koṭibhirvedavidvadbhirgayāyāṃ pitṛvatsalaiḥ ..
bhojitairyatsamāpnoti tatphalaṃ daityanāyaka .. 11 ..
15.40.d:
कोटिभिर्वेदविद्वद्भिर्गयायां पितृवत्सलैः ॥
भोजितैर्यत्समाप्नोति तत्फलं दैत्यनायक ॥ 11 ॥
15.40.m: The reward that one attains at Gayā by feeding crores of brahmins / learned in the Veda and loving to their ancestors, O leader of the Daityas,

15.40.s:
ekasminbhojite pautra bhikṣuke phalamīdṛśam..
dātavyaṃ bhikṣuke cānnaṃ kuryyādvai cātmavikrayam .. 12 ..
15.40.d:
एकस्मिन्भोजिते पौत्र भिक्षुके फलमीदृशम्॥
दातव्यं भिक्षुके चान्नं कुर्य्याद्वै चात्मविक्रयम् ॥ 12 ॥
15.40.m: such a reward is obtained, O grandson, when a single mendicant is fed. / Food should be given to a mendicant, even if one must sell oneself.

15.40.s:
dhanyāste yatayaḥ sarve ye vasaṃti kalau yuge ..
kṛṣṇamāśritya daityendra dvārakāyāṃ dinedine .. 13 ..
15.40.d:
धन्यास्ते यतयः सर्वे ये वसंति कलौ युगे ॥
कृष्णमाश्रित्य दैत्येन्द्र द्वारकायां दिनेदिने ॥ 13 ॥
15.40.m: Fortunate are all those ascetics who dwell in the Kali age, / having taken refuge in Kṛṣṇa in Dvārakā day after day, O lord of Daityas.

15.40.s:
prāṇino ye mṛtāḥ keciddvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
pāpinastatpadaṃ yāṃti bhittvā sūryasya maṃḍalam .. 14 ..
15.40.d:
प्राणिनो ये मृताः केचिद्द्वारकां कृष्णसन्निधौ ॥
पापिनस्तत्पदं यांति भित्त्वा सूर्यस्य मंडलम् ॥ 14 ॥
15.40.m: Whatever living creatures die in Dvārakā in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / even though sinners, piercing the orb of the sun, go to that abode.

15.40.s:
dvārakācakratīrthe ye nivasaṃti narottamāḥ ..
teṣāṃ nivāritāḥ sarve yamena yamakiṃkarāḥ .. 15 ..
15.40.d:
द्वारकाचक्रतीर्थे ये निवसंति नरोत्तमाः ॥
तेषां निवारिताः सर्वे यमेन यमकिंकराः ॥ 15 ॥
15.40.m: The best among men who reside at the Cakratīrtha of Dvārakā— / for them, all the servants of Yama have been turned away by Yama.

15.40.s:
snātvā paśyaṃti gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham ..
na teṣāṃ viṣaye yūyaṃ na cāsmadviṣaye tu te .. 16 ..
15.40.d:
स्नात्वा पश्यंति गोमत्यां कृष्णं कलिमलापहम् ॥
न तेषां विषये यूयं न चास्मद्विषये तु ते ॥ 16 ॥
15.40.m: Having bathed in the Gomatī, they behold Kṛṣṇa, who removes the impurities of the Kali age. / 'You have no authority over them, nor do they belong in our domain.'

15.40.s:
api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā vṛkṣā vā ye tadāśritāḥ ..
yāṃti te kṛṣṇasadanaṃ saṃsāre na punarhiṃ te .. 17 ..
15.40.d:
अपि कीटः पतंगो वा वृक्षा वा ये तदाश्रिताः ॥
यांति ते कृष्णसदनं संसारे न पुनर्हिं ते ॥ 17 ॥
15.40.m: Even a worm or an insect or trees that have taken refuge there, / they go to Kṛṣṇa's abode; they never again enter into saṃsāra.

15.40.s:
kiṃ punardvijavaryyāśca kṣatriyāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
trivarṇapūjāsaṃyuktāḥ śūdrāstatra nivāsinaḥ .. 18 ..
15.40.d:
किं पुनर्द्विजवर्य्याश्च क्षत्रियाश्च विशेषतः ॥
त्रिवर्णपूजासंयुक्ताः शूद्रास्तत्र निवासिनः ॥ 18 ॥
15.40.m: How much more so the best of the twice-born, and especially the kṣatriyas, / and the śūdras dwelling there engaged in serving the three classes!

15.40.s:
gītāṃ paṭhaṃti kṛṣṇāgre kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ dvijāḥ ..
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca .. 19 ..
15.40.d:
गीतां पठंति कृष्णाग्रे कार्तिकं सकलं द्विजाः ॥
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ॥ 19 ॥
15.40.m: The twice-born who recite the Gītā before Kṛṣṇa throughout the entire month of Kārtika, / by eating once a day, eating at night, or eating unasked food,

15.40.s:
trirātreṇāpi kṛcchreṇa tathā cāndrāyaṇena ca ..
yāvakaistaptakṛcchrādyaiḥ pakṣamāsamupoṣaṇaiḥ .. 7.4.40.20 ..
15.40.d:
त्रिरात्रेणापि कृच्छ्रेण तथा चान्द्रायणेन च ॥
यावकैस्तप्तकृच्छ्राद्यैः पक्षमासमुपोषणैः ॥ 7.4.40.20 ॥
15.40.m: by a three-night fast, a kṛcchra penance, and a cāndrāyaṇa penance, / by barley meals, the taptakṛcchra, and other penances, and by fasting for a fortnight or a month,

15.40.s:
kṣapayaṃti ca ye māsaṃ kārtikaṃ vratacāriṇaḥ ..
snātvā vai gomatīnīre tathā vai rukmiṇīhrade .. 21 ..
15.40.d:
क्षपयंति च ये मासं कार्तिकं व्रतचारिणः ॥
स्नात्वा वै गोमतीनीरे तथा वै रुक्मिणीह्रदे ॥ 21 ॥
15.40.m: and those practicing vows who spend the month of Kārtika, / having bathed in the water of the Gomatī and also in the Rukmiṇī pool,

15.40.s:
śaṃkhacakragadā hastāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā bhavaṃti te ..
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ daśamīsaṃgavarjitām .. 22 ..
15.40.d:
शंखचक्रगदा हस्ताः कृष्णरूपा भवंति ते ॥
उपोष्यैकादशीं शुद्धां दशमीसंगवर्जिताम् ॥ 22 ॥
15.40.m: they become forms of Kṛṣṇa, with conch, discus, and mace in hand. / Having fasted on the pure Ekādaśī, free from contact with Daśamī,

15.40.s:
śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti dvādaśyāṃ cakratīrthe ca nirmale ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca madhupāyasasarpiṣā .. 23 ..
15.40.d:
श्राद्धं कुर्वंति द्वादश्यां चक्रतीर्थे च निर्मले ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा च मधुपायससर्पिषा ॥ 23 ॥
15.40.m: they perform a śrāddha on Dvādaśī at the spotless Cakratīrtha, / and having fed brahmins with honey, milk-rice, and ghee,

15.40.s:
saṃtarpya vidhivadbhaktyā śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām ..
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalāni ca .. 24 ..
15.40.d:
संतर्प्य विधिवद्भक्त्या शक्त्या दत्त्वा तु दक्षिणाम् ॥
गोभूहिरण्यवासांसि तांबूलं च फलानि च ॥ 24 ॥
15.40.m: having gratified them duly with devotion and given a dakṣiṇā according to their means, / [namely] cows, land, gold, garments, betel, and fruits,

15.40.s:
upānahau cchatrasumaṃ jalapūrṇā ghaṭāstathā ..
pakvānnasaṃyutāḥ śubhrāḥ saphalā dakṣiṇānvitāḥ.. 25 ..
15.40.d:
उपानहौ च्छत्रसुमं जलपूर्णा घटास्तथा ॥
पक्वान्नसंयुताः शुभ्राः सफला दक्षिणान्विताः॥ 25 ॥
15.40.m: shoes, an umbrella, flowers, and jars filled with water, / bright, accompanied by cooked food, with fruits, and accompanied by a dakṣiṇā—

15.40.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyakkṛṣṇamuddiśya kārtike ..
mārkaṃḍeya samā prītiḥ pitṝṇāṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 26 ..
15.40.d:
एवं यः कुरुते सम्यक्कृष्णमुद्दिश्य कार्तिके ॥
मार्कंडेय समा प्रीतिः पितॄणां जायते ध्रुवम् ॥ 26 ॥
15.40.m: one who performs this properly dedicated to Kṛṣṇa in Kārtika, / O Mārkaṇḍeya, an equal pleasure surely arises for his ancestors,

15.40.s: kṛṣṇasya tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ tuṣṭirbhavati cākṣayā .. 27 ..
15.40.d: कृष्णस्य त्रिदशैः सार्द्धं तुष्टिर्भवति चाक्षया ॥ 27 ॥
15.40.m: and imperishable satisfaction arises for Kṛṣṇa together with the gods.

15.40.s:
ye kārtike puṇyatamā manuṣyāstiṣṭhaṃti māsaṃ vratadānayuktāḥ ..
rathāṃgatīrthe kṛtapūtagātrāste yāṃti puṇyaṃ padamavyayaṃ ca .. 28 ..
15.40.d:
ये कार्तिके पुण्यतमा मनुष्यास्तिष्ठंति मासं व्रतदानयुक्ताः ॥
रथांगतीर्थे कृतपूतगात्रास्ते यांति पुण्यं पदमव्ययं च ॥ 28 ॥
15.40.m: Those most virtuous men who stay for a month in Kārtika engaged in vows and gifts, / their bodies purified at the Rathāṅgatīrtha, go to the auspicious and imperishable realm.

15.40.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kārtike cakratīrthasnānadānaśrāddhādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 40 ..
15.40.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये कार्तिके चक्रतीर्थस्नानदानश्राद्धादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः॥ 40 ॥
15.40.m: Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bathing, Giving, and Śrāddha at Cakratīrtha in Kārtika', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

15.41.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
dhanyāstu naralokāste gomatyāṃ tu kṛtodakāḥ ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ ketakītulasīdalaiḥ .. 1 ..
15.41.d:
॥ श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
धन्यास्तु नरलोकास्ते गोमत्यां तु कृतोदकाः ॥
पूजयिष्यंति ये कृष्णं केतकीतुलसीदलैः ॥ 1 ॥
15.41.m: Śrī Prahlāda said: / Fortunate are those mortals who have offered libations in the Gomatī / and who worship Kṛṣṇa with ketakī flowers and tulasī leaves.

15.41.s:
na teṣāṃ saṃbhavo'stīha ghorasaṃsā ragahvare ..
teṣāṃ mṛtyuḥ punarnāsti hyamaratvaṃ hi te gatāḥ .. 2 ..
15.41.d:
न तेषां संभवोऽस्तीह घोरसंसा रगह्वरे ॥
तेषां मृत्युः पुनर्नास्ति ह्यमरत्वं हि ते गताः ॥ 2 ॥
15.41.m: There is no rebirth for them here in the terrible abyss of saṃsāra; / there is no death for them again, for they have attained immortality.

15.41.s:
anyatra vai yatīnāṃ tu koṭīnāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet ..
dvārakāyāṃ tu caikena bhojitena tato'dhikam .. 3 ..
15.41.d:
अन्यत्र वै यतीनां तु कोटीनां यत्फलं भवेत् ॥
द्वारकायां तु चैकेन भोजितेन ततोऽधिकम् ॥ 3 ॥
15.41.m: Whatever reward there may be elsewhere from feeding crores of ascetics, / that and more is gained in Dvārakā by feeding just one.

15.41.s:
atītaṃ varttamānaṃ ca bhaviṣyadyacca pātakam ..
nirddahennāsti saṃdeho dvārakā manasā smṛtā .. 4 ..
15.41.d:
अतीतं वर्त्तमानं च भविष्यद्यच्च पातकम् ॥
निर्द्दहेन्नास्ति संदेहो द्वारका मनसा स्मृता ॥ 4 ॥
15.41.m: Dvārakā, when remembered with the mind, burns away sin— / past, present, and future; of this there is no doubt.

15.41.s:
jñātvā kaliyuge ghore hāhābhūtamacetanam..
dvārakāṃ ye na muñcanti kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ .. 5 ..
15.41.d:
ज्ञात्वा कलियुगे घोरे हाहाभूतमचेतनम्॥
द्वारकां ये न मुञ्चन्ति कृतार्थास्ते नरोत्तमाः ॥ 5 ॥
15.41.m: Knowing that in the terrible Kali age the world has become lifeless and filled with lamentation, / those best of men who do not leave Dvārakā have attained their life's purpose.

15.41.s: mṛtānāṃ yatra jaṃtūnāṃ śvetadvīpe sthitiḥ sadā .. 6 ..
15.41.d: मृतानां यत्र जंतूनां श्वेतद्वीपे स्थितिः सदा ॥ 6 ॥
15.41.m: For creatures who die there, residence is always in Śvetadvīpa.

15.41.s:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāśca ye ..
ekaviṃśatiḥ pitṛgaṇā dvārakāyāṃ vasaṃti te.. 7 ..
15.41.d:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आज्यपाः सोमपाश्च ये ॥
एकविंशतिः पितृगणा द्वारकायां वसंति ते॥ 7 ॥
15.41.m: The Agniṣvāttas, Barhiṣads, Ājyapas, and Somapas— / the twenty-one classes of ancestors, they dwell in Dvārakā.

15.41.s:
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā ..
kurukṣetrādi kṣetrāṇi kāśyādīnyūṣarāṇi ca .. 8 ..
15.41.d:
पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि गंगाद्याः सरितस्तथा ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रादि क्षेत्राणि काश्यादीन्यूषराणि च ॥ 8 ॥
15.41.m: Tīrthas such as Puṣkara, rivers such as the Gaṅgā, / sacred fields such as Kurukṣetra, and saline grounds such as Kāśī,

15.41.s:
gayādipitṛtīrthāni prabhāsādyāni yāni ca ..
sthānāni yāni puṇyāni grāmāśca nivasaṃti vai .. 9 ..
15.41.d:
गयादिपितृतीर्थानि प्रभासाद्यानि यानि च ॥
स्थानानि यानि पुण्यानि ग्रामाश्च निवसंति वै ॥ 9 ॥
15.41.m: ancestral tīrthas such as Gayā, and whatever ones such as Prabhāsa, / and whatever sacred places and villages exist, they indeed dwell [there].

15.41.s:
kāśyādipuryo yā nityaṃ nivasaṃti kalau yuge ..
nityaṃ kṛṣṇasya sadane pāpināṃ muktide sadā .. 7.4.41.10 ..
15.41.d:
काश्यादिपुर्यो या नित्यं निवसंति कलौ युगे ॥
नित्यं कृष्णस्य सदने पापिनां मुक्तिदे सदा ॥ 7.4.41.10 ॥
15.41.m: The cities such as Kāśī that continually dwell in the Kali age, / constantly reside in the abode of Kṛṣṇa, which always grants liberation to sinners.

15.41.s:
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ śeṣataḥ ..
vaiśākhyāṃ daityaśārdūla kalpādiṣu yugādiṣu .. 11 ..
15.41.d:
वैशाखशुक्लद्वादश्यां प्रबोधिन्यां शेषतः ॥
वैशाख्यां दैत्यशार्दूल कल्पादिषु युगादिषु ॥ 11 ॥
15.41.m: Especially on the bright Dvādaśī of Vaiśākha, on the Prabodhinī, / on the full moon of Vaiśākha, O tiger among Daityas, on the beginnings of kalpas and yugas,

15.41.s:
caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu manvādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ ..
vyatīpāteṣu saṃkrāṃtau vaidhṛtau daityanāyaka .. 12 ..
15.41.d:
चंद्रसूर्योपरागेषु मन्वादिषु न संशयः ॥
व्यतीपातेषु संक्रांतौ वैधृतौ दैत्यनायक ॥ 12 ॥
15.41.m: during eclipses of the moon and sun, and on the beginnings of manvantaras—without a doubt— / on Vyatīpātas, at a saṃkrānti, and on Vaidhṛti, O lord of the Daityas,

15.41.s:
tilodakaṃ ca yaddatta tatsthale pitṛbhaktitaḥ ..
tatsarvamakṣayaṃ proktaṃ gomatyāṃ snānapūrvakam ..13 ..
15.41.d:
तिलोदकं च यद्दत्त तत्स्थले पितृभक्तितः ॥
तत्सर्वमक्षयं प्रोक्तं गोमत्यां स्नानपूर्वकम् ॥13 ॥
15.41.m: whatever water with sesame seeds is offered in that place out of devotion to ancestors / preceded by a bath in the Gomatī, all of that is declared to be imperishable.

15.41.s:
ye'tra śrāddhaṃ prakurvaṃti piṃḍadānapuraḥsaram ..
teṣāmatrākṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāmupajāyate .. 14 ..
15.41.d:
येऽत्र श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वंति पिंडदानपुरःसरम् ॥
तेषामत्राक्षया तृप्तिः पितॄणामुपजायते ॥ 14 ॥
15.41.m: For those who perform a śrāddha here preceded by offering balls of rice, / everlasting satisfaction of their ancestors arises here.

15.41.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturtha dvārakāmāhātmye gomatīsnāna kṛṣṇapūjana yatibhojana dāna śrāddhādisatphalavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 41 ..
15.41.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थ द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमतीस्नान कृष्णपूजन यतिभोजन दान श्राद्धादिसत्फलवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ 41 ॥
15.41.m: Thus ends the forty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Virtuous Fruits of Bathing in the Gomatī, Worshiping Kṛṣṇa, Feeding Ascetics, Giving Gifts, Śrāddha, and the Like', in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

15.42.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
vṛṣotsargaṃ kariṣyaṃti vaiśākhyāṃ caiva kārtike ..
dvārakāyāṃ piśācatvaṃ muktvā yāṃti pitāmahāḥ .. 1 ..
15.42.d:
॥ प्रह्लाद उवाच ॥ ॥
वृषोत्सर्गं करिष्यंति वैशाख्यां चैव कार्तिके ॥
द्वारकायां पिशाचत्वं मुक्त्वा यांति पितामहाः ॥ 1 ॥
15.42.m: Prahlāda said: / Those who perform the release of a bull in Dvārakā on the full moon of Vaiśākha and in Kārtika, / their ancestors are freed from ghosthood and depart [to heaven].

15.42.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ ..
evaṃvidhāni pāpāni kṛtvā caiva gurūṇyapi.. 2 ..
15.42.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः ॥
एवंविधानि पापानि कृत्वा चैव गुरूण्यपि॥ 2 ॥
15.42.m: Even having committed such heavy sins / as murdering a brahmin, drinking liquor, theft, and union with the guru's wife,

15.42.s:
snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca darśanāt ..
vilayaṃ yāti daityendra kalpakoṭikṛtānyapi .. 3 ..
15.42.d:
स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां श्रीकृष्णस्य च दर्शनात् ॥
विलयं याति दैत्येन्द्र कल्पकोटिकृतान्यपि ॥ 3 ॥
15.42.m: by merely bathing in the Gomatī and seeing the glorious Kṛṣṇa, / O lord of Daityas, even those [sins] committed over ten million kalpas dissolve away.

15.42.s:
rukmiṇīṃ ye prapaśyaṃti bhaktiyuktāḥ kalau narāḥ ..
purīṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā japtvā nāmasahasrakam .. 4 ..
15.42.d:
रुक्मिणीं ये प्रपश्यंति भक्तियुक्ताः कलौ नराः ॥
पुरीं प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा जप्त्वा नामसहस्रकम् ॥ 4 ॥
15.42.m: Those men in the Kali age who, endowed with devotion, look upon Rukmiṇī, / circumambulate the city, and recite the Thousand Names,

15.42.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
mahādānaistu cānyatra yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam..
dvārakāyāṃ tu rukmiṇyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāṃ jāyate tadā .. 5 ..
15.42.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृतं सर्वं ब्रह्मांडं नात्र संशयः ॥
महादानैस्तु चान्यत्र यत्फलं परिकीर्तितम्॥
द्वारकायां तु रुक्मिण्यां दृष्टायां जायते तदा ॥ 5 ॥
15.42.m: have circumambulated the entire universe, no doubt about it. / The fruit that is proclaimed for great gifts elsewhere, / that arises then upon seeing Rukmiṇī in Dvārakā.

15.42.s:
dvādaśīvāsare prāpte māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
paṭhate saṃnidhau viṣṇoḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tatphalam .. 6 ..
15.42.d:
द्वादशीवासरे प्राप्ते माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ॥
पठते संनिधौ विष्णोः शृणु वक्ष्यामि तत्फलम् ॥ 6 ॥
15.42.m: When the day of Dvādaśī has arrived, / hear, I shall speak of the fruit for one who reads the Dvārakā māhātmya in the presence of Viṣṇu.

15.42.s:
sarveṣu caiva lokeṣu kāmacārī virājate ..
padmavarṇena yānena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā .. 7 ..
15.42.d:
सर्वेषु चैव लोकेषु कामचारी विराजते ॥
पद्मवर्णेन यानेन किंकिणीजालमालिना ॥ 7 ॥
15.42.m: Moving at will, he shines in all the worlds, / mounted on a lotus-colored vehicle adorned with a network of tinkling bells,

15.42.s:
